short_description.id: Bükrek dan Sangal adalah sepasang naga dalam mitologi Turki dan Altai: Bükrek naga baik penghuni samudra besar, Sangal naga jahat dari laut api, dan keduanya terus berperang.
short_description.en: Bükrek and Sangal are a pair of dragons in Turkic and Altai mythology: Bükrek, the good dragon of the great ocean, and Sangal, the evil dragon of the sea of fire, locked in endless war.

long_description.id: Mitologi Turki dan Altai mengenal dua naga yang terus bertempur dengan buas, Bükrek dan Sangal. Saat keduanya bergulat, sosok mereka disebut mirip lambang yin dan yang. Keduanya tampak seperti kadal raksasa berleher panjang dengan cakar yang amat kuat; mereka tidak bersayap sehingga tidak dapat terbang.
long_description.en: Turkic and Altai mythology knows two dragons, Bükrek and Sangal, that wage a savage and endless war. When they grapple, their shapes are said to resemble the yin and yang symbol. Both look like huge long-necked lizards with very powerful claws; they have no wings and therefore cannot fly.

long_description.id: Bükrek, yang juga disebut Bükre atau Bukrak, berwatak baik: ia tidak mencelakai manusia dan malah menolong mereka. Ia menghuni samudra besar di ujung dunia, tempat semua laut bertemu. Suaranya digambarkan sangat merdu dan terdengar sampai ke sisi lain dunia, sehingga naga-naga jahat yang mendengarnya lari mencari tempat sembunyi.
long_description.en: Bükrek, also called Bükre or Bukrak, is good-natured: it does not harm people and even helps them. It inhabits the great ocean at the end of the world where all seas meet. Its voice is described as very sweet and audible on the far side of the world, so evil dragons that hear it run to hide.

long_description.id: Sangal, atau Sankal, adalah naga yang mewakili kekuatan jahat dan konon tinggal di Oddeniz, laut api di ujung dunia. Ia kalah setelah berperang sembilan tahun melawan Bükrek. Menurut riwayat, Bükrek turun ke bumi sekali setiap seribu tahun untuk menata keadaan.
long_description.en: Sangal, or Sankal, is the dragon that stands for the forces of evil and is said to live in the Oddeniz, the sea of fire at the end of the world. It was defeated after a nine-year war against Bükrek. According to legend, Bükrek comes down to earth once every thousand years to set things in order.

literal_meaning.id: yang melengkung, yang melingkar (untuk nama Bükrek)
literal_meaning.en: that which bends or coils (for the name Bükrek)

who.id: Sepasang naga, satu baik dan satu jahat.
who.en: A pair of dragons, one good and one evil.

origin.id: Keduanya berasal dari mitologi Turki dan Altai.
origin.en: They come from Turkic and Altai mythology.

role.id: Mereka melambangkan pertarungan abadi antara kekuatan baik dan jahat.
role.en: They embody the endless struggle between good and evil forces.

famous_for.id: Bükrek menang setelah perang sembilan tahun melawan Sangal.
famous_for.en: Bükrek won after a nine-year war against Sangal.

did_you_know.id: Suara Bükrek konon begitu merdu sehingga terdengar dari ujung dunia yang lain dan membuat naga-naga jahat lari.
did_you_know.en: Bükrek's voice is said to be so sweet that it is heard from the other end of the world and sends evil dragons fleeing.

description.id: Suara Bükrek terdengar sampai ujung dunia dan membuat naga jahat melarikan diri.
description.en: Bükrek's voice carries to the end of the world and makes evil dragons flee.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa banyak tradisi menggambarkan pertarungan baik dan jahat sebagai perkelahian dua makhluk?
learning_questions.en: Why do many traditions picture the struggle of good and evil as a fight between two creatures?

learning_questions.id: Apa bedanya naga dalam kisah ini dengan naga bersayap yang dikenal di tempat lain?
learning_questions.en: How do the dragons in this story differ from winged dragons known elsewhere?

short_description.id: Kematian adalah personifikasi kematian dalam berbagai mitologi dunia, kerap digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit atau pemandu jiwa.
short_description.en: Death is the personification of dying in global mythologies, often portrayed as a cloaked skeleton wielding a scythe or as a guiding psychopomp.

long_description.id: Personifikasi kematian hadir dalam banyak mitologi dan agama di dunia, serta digambarkan sebagai salah satu dari Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Dalam kisah modern, sosok ini sering dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper berwujud kerangka berjubah yang membawa sabit untuk menjemput jiwa. Pandangan lain menganggap sosok kematian adalah psychopomp atau pemandu yang bertugas mengantar orang yang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan saat terjadinya ajal.
long_description.en: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies, portrayed among the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. In modern stories, this figure is known as the Grim Reaper, depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls. Other beliefs describe death as a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when a person dies.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Greek, Thanatos dipandang sebagai perwujudan roh kematian tanpa kekerasan, bertangan lembut mendampingi saudaranya Hypnos, sedangkan kematian akibat kekerasan berada di ranah saudari-saudarinya, Keres. Seni lukis vas Greek dan relief Roman menggambarkan sosoknya bersayap atau membawa obor dan kupu-kupu penanda jiwa. Di berbagai belahan dunia sosok kematian juga berwujud perempuan seperti Santa Muerte di Mexico, sebutan la Parca di Latin America, serta kostucha di Poland dengan jubah putih.
long_description.en: In Greek traditions, Thanatos was regarded as the personified spirit of non-violent death with a gentle touch alongside his brother Hypnos, while violent death belonged to his sisters, the Keres. Greek vase painting and Roman reliefs depicted him with wings or holding a torch and butterfly. Worldwide, death also takes female forms such as Santa Muerte in Mexico, la Parca across Latin America, and kostucha in Poland with a white robe.

note.id: Hypnos adalah saudara kembar Thanatos.
note.en: Hypnos is the twin brother of Thanatos.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana pandangan terhadap kematian berkembang dari pemandu jiwa yang lembut menjadi sosok kerangka bersabit yang ditakuti?
learning_questions.en: How did views of death evolve from a gentle guide of souls into a feared skeletal figure bearing a scythe?

claims.quote: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies.

statement.id: Personifikasi kematian ditemukan dalam banyak agama dan mitologi.
statement.en: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies.

claims.quote: In more modern stories, a character known as the Grim Reaper (usually depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe) causes the victim's death by coming to collect that person's soul.

statement.id: Dalam kisah modern, sosok yang dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit pencabut jiwa.
statement.en: In more modern stories, the Grim Reaper is depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls.

claims.quote: Other beliefs hold that the spectre of death is only a psychopomp, a benevolent figure who serves to gently sever the last ties between the soul and the body, and to guide the deceased to the afterlife, without having any control over when or how the victim dies.

statement.id: Kepercayaan lain memandang kematian sebagai psychopomp yang memandu orang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan kapan atau bagaimana orang itu meninggal.
statement.en: Other beliefs hold that death is a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when or how they die.

claims.quote: Death is most often personified in male form, although in certain cultures death is perceived as female (for instance, Marzanna in Slavic mythology, or Santa Muerte in Mexico).

statement.id: Kematian kerap dipersonifikasikan dalam wujud pria, meski di budaya tertentu berwujud perempuan seperti Santa Muerte di Mexico.
statement.en: Death is most often personified in male form, although in certain cultures it is perceived as female, such as Santa Muerte in Mexico.

claims.quote: Death is also portrayed as one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

statement.id: Kematian juga digambarkan sebagai salah satu dari Empat Penunggang Kuda Apokalips.
statement.en: Death is also portrayed as one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

claims.quote: In Aztec mythology, Mictecacihuatl is the "Queen of Mictlan" (the Aztec underworld), ruling over the afterlife with her husband, Mictlantecuhtli.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aztek, Mictecacihuatl memerintah alam baka bawah tanah Mictlan bersama suaminya Mictlantecuhtli.
statement.en: In Aztec mythology, Mictecacihuatl rules over the Mictlan underworld with her husband Mictlantecuhtli.

claims.quote: A common term for the personification of death across Latin America is "la Parca" from one of the three Roman Parcae, a figure similar to the Anglophone Grim Reaper, though usually depicted as female and without a scythe.

statement.id: Sebutan umum bagi personifikasi kematian di Latin America adalah la Parca.
statement.en: A common term for the personification of death across Latin America is la Parca.

claims.quote: In Poland, Death – Śmierć or kostucha – has an appearance similar to the Grim Reaper, although its robe was traditionally white instead of black.

statement.id: Di Poland, kostucha memiliki penampilan mirip Grim Reaper dengan jubah putih.
statement.en: In Poland, kostucha has an appearance similar to the Grim Reaper with a white robe.

claims.quote: THANATOS was the god or personified spirit ( daimon ) of non-violent death.

statement.id: Thanatos adalah dewa atau roh yang mempersonifikasikan kematian tanpa kekerasan.
statement.en: Thanatos was the god or personified spirit of non-violent death.

claims.quote: His touch was gentle, likened to that of his twin brother Hypnos (Sleep).

statement.id: Sentuhan Thanatos lembut, diserupakan dengan saudara kembarnya Hypnos.
statement.en: Thanatos' touch was gentle, likened to that of his twin brother Hypnos.

claims.quote: Violent death was the domain of Thanatos' blood-craving sisters, the Keres , spirits of slaughter and disease.

statement.id: Kematian akibat kekerasan merupakan ranah saudari-saudari Thanatos, yaitu Keres.
statement.en: Violent death was the domain of Thanatos' sisters, the Keres.

claims.quote: In Greek vase painting Thanatos was depicted as a winged, bearded older man, or more rarely as a beardless youth.

statement.id: Dalam lukisan vas Greek, Thanatos digambarkan sebagai pria tua bersayap dan berjanggut.
statement.en: In Greek vase painting Thanatos was depicted as a winged, bearded older man.

claims.quote: In Roman sculptural reliefs he was portrayed as a youth holding a down-turned torch and wreath or butterfly which symbolised the soul of the dead.

statement.id: Dalam relief patung Romawi, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda pemegang obor terbalik dan kupu-kupu yang melambangkan jiwa.
statement.en: In Roman sculptural reliefs he was portrayed as a youth holding a down-turned torch and butterfly symbolizing the soul.

claims.quote: psychopomp itself comes from the Greek word ψυχοπομπός , which literally translates as ‘the guide of souls’.

statement.id: Kata psychopomp berasal dari bahasa Greek ψυχοπομπός yang berarti pemandu jiwa.
statement.en: Psychopomp comes from the Greek word ψυχοπομπός, literally translating as the guide of souls.

claims.quote: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

statement.id: Psychopomp adalah sebutan bagi makhluk, roh, atau dewa yang mengawal manusia ke alam baka.
statement.en: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

claims.quote: there is some debate about whether the Grim Reaper, the most popular personification of Death, can be classified as a psychopomp, or whether it brings about death instead.

statement.id: Terdapat perdebatan apakah Grim Reaper dapat diklasifikasikan sebagai psychopomp ataukah sosok pembawa kematian.
statement.en: There is debate about whether the Grim Reaper can be classified as a psychopomp or whether it brings about death instead.

claims.quote: Some stories believe that the Reaper has no control over when or how a person dies, and its only role is to sever the final ties between the soul and the body, guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

statement.id: Beberapa cerita memandang Reaper tidak berkuasa atas waktu kematian dan hanya bertugas memutus ikatan jiwa lalu membimbingnya ke alam baka.
statement.en: Some stories believe the Reaper has no control over when a person dies, only severing ties and guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

short_description.id: Drudwyn adalah anjing pemburu dalam mitologi Welsh, salah satu Cŵn Annwn, yang menurut kisah Kilhwch and Olwen mutlak diperlukan untuk memburu babi hutan Twrch Trwyth.
short_description.en: Drudwyn is a hunting hound of Welsh mythology, one of the Cŵn Annwn, who in the tale of Kilhwch and Olwen is indispensable for hunting the boar Twrch Trwyth.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Welsh, Drudwyn tergolong Cŵn Annwn, anjing-anjing Annwn. Ia digambarkan bertelinga merah dan bertubuh putih. Dalam terjemahan Guest ia disebut anak anjing milik Greid putra Eri, sedangkan Wikipedia Jerman menyebutnya anjing muda Greid dan putra Eri.
long_description.en: In Welsh mythology Drudwyn is one of the Cŵn Annwn, the hounds of Annwn. He is described as having red ears and a white body. Guest's translation calls him the whelp of Greid the son of Eri, while the German Wikipedia calls him the young dog of Greid and a son of Eri.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Kilhwch and Olwen, Drudwyn masuk daftar tugas yang hampir mustahil: babi hutan Twrch Trwyth tidak bisa diburu tanpa dia. Tidak ada tali kekang yang dapat menahannya kecuali tali kekang Cwrs Cant Ewin, dan menurut Kai hanya tali dari janggut Dillus Varvawc yang mampu mengikatnya. Hanya Mabon putra Modron yang dapat berburu bersamanya.
long_description.en: In the tale of Kilhwch and Olwen, Drudwyn is part of the near-impossible tasks: the boar Twrch Trwyth cannot be hunted without him. No leash can hold him except the leash of Cwrs Cant Ewin, and according to Kai only a leash made from the beard of Dillus Varvawc can bind him. Only Mabon the son of Modron can hunt with him.

long_description.id: Setelah Arthur memutuskan untuk mencari Drudwyn, anjing itu ikut dalam perburuan Yskithyrwyn Penbaedd bersama dua anjing Glythmyr Ledewic, walaupun babi hutan itu akhirnya dibunuh oleh Cavall, anjing Arthur sendiri. Dalam perburuan Twrch Trwyth, Eli dan Trachmyr menuntun Drudwyn. Wikipedia Jerman meringkasnya dengan menyebut Drudwyn menangkap Twrch Trwyth untuk Mabon ap Modron sehingga Mabon dapat merebut sisir dan gunting dari babi hutan itu.
long_description.en: After Arthur decided to seek Drudwyn, the hound took part in the hunt of Yskithyrwyn Penbaedd together with the two dogs of Glythmyr Ledewic, though that boar was finally slain by Cavall, Arthur's own dog. In the hunt of Twrch Trwyth, Eli and Trachmyr led Drudwyn. The German Wikipedia summarises this by saying Drudwyn caught Twrch Trwyth for Mabon ap Modron so that Mabon could snatch the comb and scissors from the boar.

short_description.id: Drudwyn adalah anjing pemburu dalam mitologi Welsh, salah satu Cŵn Annwn, yang menurut kisah Kilhwch and Olwen mutlak diperlukan untuk memburu babi hutan Twrch Trwyth.
short_description.en: Drudwyn is a hunting hound of Welsh mythology, one of the Cŵn Annwn, who in the tale of Kilhwch and Olwen is indispensable for hunting the boar Twrch Trwyth.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Welsh, Drudwyn tergolong Cŵn Annwn, anjing-anjing Annwn. Ia digambarkan bertelinga merah dan bertubuh putih. Dalam terjemahan Guest ia disebut anak anjing milik Greid putra Eri, sedangkan Wikipedia Jerman menyebutnya anjing muda Greid dan putra Eri.
long_description.en: In Welsh mythology Drudwyn is one of the Cŵn Annwn, the hounds of Annwn. He is described as having red ears and a white body. Guest's translation calls him the whelp of Greid the son of Eri, while the German Wikipedia calls him the young dog of Greid and a son of Eri.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Kilhwch and Olwen, Drudwyn masuk daftar tugas yang hampir mustahil: babi hutan Twrch Trwyth tidak bisa diburu tanpa dia. Tidak ada tali kekang yang dapat menahannya kecuali tali kekang Cwrs Cant Ewin, dan menurut Kai hanya tali dari janggut Dillus Varvawc yang mampu mengikatnya. Hanya Mabon putra Modron yang dapat berburu bersamanya.
long_description.en: In the tale of Kilhwch and Olwen, Drudwyn is part of the near-impossible tasks: the boar Twrch Trwyth cannot be hunted without him. No leash can hold him except the leash of Cwrs Cant Ewin, and according to Kai only a leash made from the beard of Dillus Varvawc can bind him. Only Mabon the son of Modron can hunt with him.

long_description.id: Setelah Arthur memutuskan untuk mencari Drudwyn, anjing itu ikut dalam perburuan Yskithyrwyn Penbaedd bersama dua anjing Glythmyr Ledewic, walaupun babi hutan itu akhirnya dibunuh oleh Cavall, anjing Arthur sendiri. Dalam perburuan Twrch Trwyth, Eli dan Trachmyr menuntun Drudwyn. Wikipedia Jerman meringkasnya dengan menyebut Drudwyn menangkap Twrch Trwyth untuk Mabon ap Modron sehingga Mabon dapat merebut sisir dan gunting dari babi hutan itu.
long_description.en: After Arthur decided to seek Drudwyn, the hound took part in the hunt of Yskithyrwyn Penbaedd together with the two dogs of Glythmyr Ledewic, though that boar was finally slain by Cavall, Arthur's own dog. In the hunt of Twrch Trwyth, Eli and Trachmyr led Drudwyn. The German Wikipedia summarises this by saying Drudwyn caught Twrch Trwyth for Mabon ap Modron so that Mabon could snatch the comb and scissors from the boar.

short_description.id: Eog Llyn Llyw adalah ikan salmon (eog) dari kisah Culhwch ac Olwen, yang disebut sebagai yang tertua dan terbijak di antara Hewan-Hewan Tertua; ia mengantar utusan Arthur ke penjara Mabon fab Modron.
short_description.en: Eog Llyn Llyw, the Salmon of Llyn Llyw, is a salmon (eog) in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen, called the oldest and wisest of the Oldest Animals; it carries Arthur's envoys to the prison of Mabon fab Modron.

long_description.id: Eog Llyn Llyw muncul dalam kisah Culhwch ac Olwen sebagai salah satu Hewan-Hewan Tertua (Anifeiliaid Hynaf), dan menurut satu ensiklopedia daring ia yang tertua dan terbijak di antara mereka. Salah satu tugas mustahil (anoethau) yang diberikan Ysbaddaden Bencawr kepada Culhwch adalah membebaskan Mabon fab Modron dari penjaranya. Utusan Arthur menanyai hewan-hewan tua satu demi satu, dan Eryr Gwern Abwy (Elang Gwern Abwy) membawa mereka kepada sang salmon.
long_description.en: Eog Llyn Llyw appears in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen as one of the Oldest Animals (Anifeiliaid Hynaf), and according to one online encyclopedia it is the oldest and wisest of them. One of the impossible tasks (anoethau) that Ysbaddaden Bencawr sets Culhwch is to free Mabon fab Modron from his prison. Arthur's envoys question the old animals in turn, and Eryr Gwern Abwy (the Eagle of Gwern Abwy) leads them to the salmon.

long_description.id: Dalam terjemahan Guest, sang elang bercerita bahwa ia pernah mencengkeram salmon itu di Llyn Llyw untuk dimakan, tetapi salmon itu menyeretnya ke dalam air dalam sehingga ia nyaris tidak bisa lolos. Elang itu kemudian menyerangnya bersama seluruh kerabatnya, tetapi salmon itu mengirim utusan untuk berdamai dan meminta sang elang mencabut lima puluh tombak ikan dari punggungnya.
long_description.en: In Guest's translation the eagle relates that it once struck its talons into the salmon at Llyn Llyw for food, but the salmon drew it into the deep so that it barely escaped. The eagle then attacked it with its whole kindred, but the salmon sent messengers to make peace and asked the eagle to take fifty fish spears out of its back.

long_description.id: Sang salmon menjelaskan bahwa setiap pasang ia berenang menyusuri sungai ke hulu hingga dekat tembok Caerloyw (Gloucester), dan di sana ia mendengar ratapan dari penjara. Ia menawarkan untuk membawa para utusan di atas kedua bahunya; mereka sampai ke tembok penjara dan berbicara dengan tahanan yang ternyata Mabon fab Modron. Ketika Arthur dan pasukannya menyerang kastel, Cei dan Bedwyr menyusuri sungai di atas bahu sang salmon, lalu Cei menjebol tembok dan membebaskan Mabon.
long_description.en: The salmon explains that with every tide it goes up the river until it comes near the walls of Caerloyw (Gloucester), and there it hears wailing from the prison. It offers to carry the envoys on its two shoulders; they reach the prison wall and speak with the prisoner, who is Mabon fab Modron. When Arthur and his host attack the castle, Cei and Bedwyr travel along the river on the salmon's shoulders, and Cei breaks through the walls and frees Mabon.

long_description.id: Eog Llyn Llyw dapat digolongkan bersama banyak contoh salmon adikodrati di dunia Celtic, tempat salmon dikaitkan dengan pengetahuan dan kebijaksanaan; pahlawan Irlandia Finn mac Cumaill, misalnya, memperoleh karunia nabi dan orang bijak setelah menyentuh salmon istimewa lalu memasukkan ibu jarinya ke mulut. long_description.en: Eog Llyn Llyw can be classed with the many examples of supernatural salmon in the Celtic world, where the salmon is associated with knowledge and wisdom; the Irish hero Finn mac Cumaill, for example, gains the gift of a prophet and sage after touching a special salmon and putting his thumb in his mouth. The location of Llyn Llyw is uncertain, but because the salmon swims upriver to Caerloyw, it is thought to lie around the lower part of Afon Hafren.

claims.quote: Eog Llyn Llyw yw'r hynaf a'r doethaf o'r Anifeiliaid Hynaf a nodir yn chwedl Culhwch ac Olwen.

statement.id: Eog Llyn Llyw adalah yang tertua (hynaf) dan terbijak (doethaf) di antara Hewan-Hewan Tertua (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) yang disebut dalam kisah (chwedl) Culhwch ac Olwen.
statement.en: Eog Llyn Llyw is the oldest (hynaf) and wisest (doethaf) of the Oldest Animals (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) named in the tale (chwedl) Culhwch ac Olwen.

claims.quote: Un o'r Anoethau (tasgau amhosibl) a osodir ar yr arwr Culhwch gan Ysbaddaden Bencawr yn y chwedl yw rhyddhau Mabon fab Modron o'i garchar.

statement.id: Salah satu Anoethau (tugas mustahil, tasgau amhosibl) yang diberikan Ysbaddaden Bencawr kepada pahlawan Culhwch dalam kisah itu adalah membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon fab Modron dari penjaranya (garchar).
statement.en: One of the Anoethau (impossible tasks, tasgau amhosibl) set on the hero Culhwch by Ysbaddaden Bencawr in the tale is to free (rhyddhau) Mabon fab Modron from his prison (garchar).

claims.quote: Mae Eryr Gwern Abwy yn eu tywys i Eog Llyn Llyw.

statement.id: Eryr Gwern Abwy menuntun (tywys) mereka kepada Eog Llyn Llyw.
statement.en: Eryr Gwern Abwy leads (tywys) them to Eog Llyn Llyw.

claims.quote: Mae'r Eog yn esbonio fel ei fod yn arfer nofio ar hyd yr afon bob nos hyd daw i furiau Caerloyw lle mae'n clywed griddfan ofnadwy yn dod o dŵr y castell.

statement.id: Sang salmon (Eog) menjelaskan bahwa ia biasa berenang (nofio) menyusuri sungai (afon) setiap malam sampai ke tembok Caerloyw (Gloucester), tempat ia mendengar rintihan mengerikan dari menara kastel.
statement.en: The Salmon (Eog) explains that it used to swim (nofio) along the river (afon) every night until it came to the walls of Caerloyw (Gloucester), where it heard terrible groaning from the castle tower.

claims.quote: Mae'n cynnig cludo Gwrhyr ac Eidoel ar ei ysgwyddau i weld drostynt eu hunain. Llwyddant i siarad â'r carcharor sydd neb llai na Mabon fab Modron.

statement.id: Ia menawarkan untuk membawa (cludo) Gwrhyr dan Eidoel di atas bahunya (ysgwyddau) agar mereka melihat sendiri; mereka berhasil berbicara dengan tahanan (carcharor), yang tak lain adalah Mabon fab Modron.
statement.en: It offers to carry (cludo) Gwrhyr and Eidoel on its shoulders (ysgwyddau) to see for themselves; they manage to speak with the prisoner (carcharor), who is none other than Mabon fab Modron.

claims.quote: aiff Cei a Bedwyr ar hyd yr afon ar ysgwyddau Eog Llyn Llyw. Cyrhaeddent y tŵr ar lan yr afon ac mae Cei yn rhwygo'r muriau ac yn rhyddhau Mabon.

statement.id: Cei dan Bedwyr menyusuri sungai (afon) di atas bahu (ysgwyddau) Eog Llyn Llyw; mereka sampai ke menara di tepi sungai, dan Cei menjebol tembok (muriau) lalu membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon.
statement.en: Cei and Bedwyr go along the river (afon) on the shoulders (ysgwyddau) of Eog Llyn Llyw; they reach the tower on the river bank, and Cei tears down the walls (muriau) and frees (rhyddhau) Mabon.

claims.quote: Gellir dosbarthu Eog Llyn Llyw gyda'r sawl enghraifft o eogiaid goruwchnaturiol ym myd y Celtiaid. Cysylltir yr eog â gwybodaeth a doethineb.

statement.id: Eog Llyn Llyw dapat digolongkan bersama banyak contoh salmon adikodrati (eogiaid goruwchnaturiol) di dunia Celtic (byd y Celtiaid); salmon (eog) dikaitkan dengan pengetahuan (gwybodaeth) dan kebijaksanaan (doethineb).
statement.en: Eog Llyn Llyw can be classed with the many examples of supernatural salmon (eogiaid goruwchnaturiol) in the Celtic world (byd y Celtiaid); the salmon (eog) is associated with knowledge (gwybodaeth) and wisdom (doethineb).

claims.quote: Mae'r arwr Gwyddelig Finn mac Cumaill er enghraifft yn cael dawn proffwyd a doethwr ar ôl rhoi ei fawd yn ei geg ar ôl cyffwrdd eog arbennig.

statement.id: Pahlawan Irlandia (arwr Gwyddelig) Finn mac Cumaill, misalnya, mendapat karunia nabi (proffwyd) dan orang bijak setelah memasukkan ibu jarinya ke mulut sesudah menyentuh salmon (eog) istimewa.
statement.en: The Irish hero (arwr Gwyddelig) Finn mac Cumaill, for example, gains the gift of a prophet (proffwyd) and sage after putting his thumb in his mouth having touched a special salmon (eog).

claims.quote: Mae lleoliad Llyn Llyw yn ansicr, ond mae'r ffaith fod yr Eog yn nofio i fyny'r afon i Gaerloyw yn awgrymu ei fod o gwmpas rhan isaf Afon Hafren.

statement.id: Letak (lleoliad) Llyn Llyw tidak pasti (ansicr), tetapi karena salmon (Eog) itu berenang ke hulu menuju Caerloyw (Gaerloyw), diduga tempat itu berada di sekitar bagian hilir Afon Hafren.
statement.en: The location (lleoliad) of Llyn Llyw is uncertain (ansicr), but the fact that the Salmon (Eog) swims upriver to Caerloyw (Gaerloyw) suggests it lies around the lower part of Afon Hafren.

claims.quote: went in search of food as far as Llyn Llyw. And when I came there, I struck my talons into a salmon, thinking he would serve me as food for a long time. But he drew me into the deep, and I was scarcely able to escape from him.

statement.id: Sang elang bercerita bahwa ia mencari makanan sampai ke Llyn Llyw, mencengkeram seekor salmon dengan cakarnya, tetapi salmon itu menyeretnya ke dalam air dalam (the deep) sehingga ia nyaris tidak bisa lolos.
statement.en: The eagle tells how it went in search of food as far as Llyn Llyw and struck its talons into a salmon, but the salmon drew it into the deep and it was scarcely able to escape.

claims.quote: After that I went with my whole kindred to attack him, and to try to destroy him, but he sent messengers, and made peace with me; and came and besought me to take fifty fish spears out of his back.

statement.id: Elang itu lalu menyerang salmon itu bersama seluruh kerabatnya, tetapi salmon itu mengirim utusan, berdamai, dan memohon agar elang mencabut lima puluh (fifty) tombak ikan dari punggungnya.
statement.en: The eagle then went with its whole kindred to attack the salmon, but the salmon sent messengers, made peace, and besought the eagle to take fifty fish spears out of its back.

claims.quote: With every tide I go along the river upwards, until I come near to the walls of Gloucester, and there have I found such wrong as I never found elsewhere

statement.id: Salmon itu berkata bahwa setiap pasang (tide) ia menyusuri sungai ke hulu sampai dekat tembok Gloucester, dan di sana ia menemukan kesalahan yang tak pernah ia temukan di tempat lain.
statement.en: The salmon says that with every tide it goes up the river until it comes near the walls of Gloucester, and there it has found such wrong as it never found elsewhere.

claims.quote: So Kai and Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd went upon the two shoulders of the salmon, and they proceeded until they came unto the wall of the prison

statement.id: Maka Kai dan Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd naik ke atas kedua bahu salmon itu dan berjalan sampai ke tembok penjara.
statement.en: So Kai and Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd went upon the two shoulders of the salmon and proceeded until they came to the wall of the prison.

claims.quote: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish, whilst the warriors of Arthur attacked the castle.

statement.id: Kai dan Bedwyr naik ke atas bahu ikan (fish) itu, sementara para prajurit Arthur menyerang kastel.
statement.en: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish while Arthur's warriors attacked the castle.

claims.quote: the place where is the oldest animal in this world, and the one that has travelled most, the Eagle of Gwern Abwy.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Guest, burung hantu menyebut Elang Gwern Abwy (Eagle of Gwern Abwy) sebagai hewan tertua (oldest animal) di dunia ini dan yang paling jauh mengembara.
statement.en: In Guest's translation the owl names the Eagle of Gwern Abwy as the oldest animal in this world and the one that has travelled most.

claims.quote: So they went thither, and the eagle said, "Salmon of Llyn Llyw, I have come to thee with an embassy from Arthur

statement.id: Dalam penceritaan ulang Jacobs, sang elang menyapa 'Salmon of Llyn Llyw' (Salmon dari Llyn Llyw) dan menyampaikan bahwa ia datang membawa utusan Arthur.
statement.en: In Jacobs's retelling the eagle addresses the 'Salmon of Llyn Llyw' and says it has come with an embassy from Arthur.

claims.quote: Eog Llyn Llyw yw'r hynaf a'r doethaf o'r Anifeiliaid Hynaf a nodir yn chwedl Culhwch ac Olwen.

statement.id: Eog Llyn Llyw adalah yang tertua (hynaf) dan terbijak (doethaf) di antara Hewan-Hewan Tertua (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) yang disebut dalam kisah (chwedl) Culhwch ac Olwen.
statement.en: Eog Llyn Llyw is the oldest (hynaf) and wisest (doethaf) of the Oldest Animals (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) named in the tale (chwedl) Culhwch ac Olwen.

claims.quote: Un o'r Anoethau (tasgau amhosibl) a osodir ar yr arwr Culhwch gan Ysbaddaden Bencawr yn y chwedl yw rhyddhau Mabon fab Modron o'i garchar.

statement.id: Salah satu Anoethau (tugas mustahil, tasgau amhosibl) yang diberikan Ysbaddaden Bencawr kepada pahlawan Culhwch dalam kisah itu adalah membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon fab Modron dari penjaranya (garchar).
statement.en: One of the Anoethau (impossible tasks, tasgau amhosibl) set on the hero Culhwch by Ysbaddaden Bencawr in the tale is to free (rhyddhau) Mabon fab Modron from his prison (garchar).

claims.quote: Mae Eryr Gwern Abwy yn eu tywys i Eog Llyn Llyw.

statement.id: Eryr Gwern Abwy menuntun (tywys) mereka kepada Eog Llyn Llyw.
statement.en: Eryr Gwern Abwy leads (tywys) them to Eog Llyn Llyw.

claims.quote: Mae'r Eog yn esbonio fel ei fod yn arfer nofio ar hyd yr afon bob nos hyd daw i furiau Caerloyw lle mae'n clywed griddfan ofnadwy yn dod o dŵr y castell.

statement.id: Sang salmon (Eog) menjelaskan bahwa ia biasa berenang (nofio) menyusuri sungai (afon) setiap malam sampai ke tembok Caerloyw (Gloucester), tempat ia mendengar rintihan mengerikan dari menara kastel.
statement.en: The Salmon (Eog) explains that it used to swim (nofio) along the river (afon) every night until it came to the walls of Caerloyw (Gloucester), where it heard terrible groaning from the castle tower.

claims.quote: Mae'n cynnig cludo Gwrhyr ac Eidoel ar ei ysgwyddau i weld drostynt eu hunain. Llwyddant i siarad â'r carcharor sydd neb llai na Mabon fab Modron.

statement.id: Ia menawarkan untuk membawa (cludo) Gwrhyr dan Eidoel di atas bahunya (ysgwyddau) agar mereka melihat sendiri; mereka berhasil berbicara dengan tahanan (carcharor), yang tak lain adalah Mabon fab Modron.
statement.en: It offers to carry (cludo) Gwrhyr and Eidoel on its shoulders (ysgwyddau) to see for themselves; they manage to speak with the prisoner (carcharor), who is none other than Mabon fab Modron.

claims.quote: aiff Cei a Bedwyr ar hyd yr afon ar ysgwyddau Eog Llyn Llyw. Cyrhaeddent y tŵr ar lan yr afon ac mae Cei yn rhwygo'r muriau ac yn rhyddhau Mabon.

statement.id: Cei dan Bedwyr menyusuri sungai (afon) di atas bahu (ysgwyddau) Eog Llyn Llyw; mereka sampai ke menara di tepi sungai, dan Cei menjebol tembok (muriau) lalu membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon.
statement.en: Cei and Bedwyr go along the river (afon) on the shoulders (ysgwyddau) of Eog Llyn Llyw; they reach the tower on the river bank, and Cei tears down the walls (muriau) and frees (rhyddhau) Mabon.

claims.quote: Gellir dosbarthu Eog Llyn Llyw gyda'r sawl enghraifft o eogiaid goruwchnaturiol ym myd y Celtiaid. Cysylltir yr eog â gwybodaeth a doethineb.

statement.id: Eog Llyn Llyw dapat digolongkan bersama banyak contoh salmon adikodrati (eogiaid goruwchnaturiol) di dunia Celtic (byd y Celtiaid); salmon (eog) dikaitkan dengan pengetahuan (gwybodaeth) dan kebijaksanaan (doethineb).
statement.en: Eog Llyn Llyw can be classed with the many examples of supernatural salmon (eogiaid goruwchnaturiol) in the Celtic world (byd y Celtiaid); the salmon (eog) is associated with knowledge (gwybodaeth) and wisdom (doethineb).

claims.quote: Mae'r arwr Gwyddelig Finn mac Cumaill er enghraifft yn cael dawn proffwyd a doethwr ar ôl rhoi ei fawd yn ei geg ar ôl cyffwrdd eog arbennig.

statement.id: Pahlawan Irlandia (arwr Gwyddelig) Finn mac Cumaill, misalnya, mendapat karunia nabi (proffwyd) dan orang bijak setelah memasukkan ibu jarinya ke mulut sesudah menyentuh salmon (eog) istimewa.
statement.en: The Irish hero (arwr Gwyddelig) Finn mac Cumaill, for example, gains the gift of a prophet (proffwyd) and sage after putting his thumb in his mouth having touched a special salmon (eog).

claims.quote: Mae lleoliad Llyn Llyw yn ansicr, ond mae'r ffaith fod yr Eog yn nofio i fyny'r afon i Gaerloyw yn awgrymu ei fod o gwmpas rhan isaf Afon Hafren.

statement.id: Letak (lleoliad) Llyn Llyw tidak pasti (ansicr), tetapi karena salmon (Eog) itu berenang ke hulu menuju Caerloyw (Gaerloyw), diduga tempat itu berada di sekitar bagian hilir Afon Hafren.
statement.en: The location (lleoliad) of Llyn Llyw is uncertain (ansicr), but the fact that the Salmon (Eog) swims upriver to Caerloyw (Gaerloyw) suggests it lies around the lower part of Afon Hafren.

claims.quote: went in search of food as far as Llyn Llyw. And when I came there, I struck my talons into a salmon, thinking he would serve me as food for a long time. But he drew me into the deep, and I was scarcely able to escape from him.

statement.id: Sang elang bercerita bahwa ia mencari makanan sampai ke Llyn Llyw, mencengkeram seekor salmon dengan cakarnya, tetapi salmon itu menyeretnya ke dalam air dalam (the deep) sehingga ia nyaris tidak bisa lolos.
statement.en: The eagle tells how it went in search of food as far as Llyn Llyw and struck its talons into a salmon, but the salmon drew it into the deep and it was scarcely able to escape.

claims.quote: After that I went with my whole kindred to attack him, and to try to destroy him, but he sent messengers, and made peace with me; and came and besought me to take fifty fish spears out of his back.

statement.id: Elang itu lalu menyerang salmon itu bersama seluruh kerabatnya, tetapi salmon itu mengirim utusan, berdamai, dan memohon agar elang mencabut lima puluh (fifty) tombak ikan dari punggungnya.
statement.en: The eagle then went with its whole kindred to attack the salmon, but the salmon sent messengers, made peace, and besought the eagle to take fifty fish spears out of its back.

claims.quote: With every tide I go along the river upwards, until I come near to the walls of Gloucester, and there have I found such wrong as I never found elsewhere

statement.id: Salmon itu berkata bahwa setiap pasang (tide) ia menyusuri sungai ke hulu sampai dekat tembok Gloucester, dan di sana ia menemukan kesalahan yang tak pernah ia temukan di tempat lain.
statement.en: The salmon says that with every tide it goes up the river until it comes near the walls of Gloucester, and there it has found such wrong as it never found elsewhere.

claims.quote: So Kai and Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd went upon the two shoulders of the salmon, and they proceeded until they came unto the wall of the prison

statement.id: Maka Kai dan Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd naik ke atas kedua bahu salmon itu dan berjalan sampai ke tembok penjara.
statement.en: So Kai and Gwrhyr Gwalstawt Ieithoedd went upon the two shoulders of the salmon and proceeded until they came to the wall of the prison.

claims.quote: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish, whilst the warriors of Arthur attacked the castle.

statement.id: Kai dan Bedwyr naik ke atas bahu ikan (fish) itu, sementara para prajurit Arthur menyerang kastel.
statement.en: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish while Arthur's warriors attacked the castle.

claims.quote: the place where is the oldest animal in this world, and the one that has travelled most, the Eagle of Gwern Abwy.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Guest, burung hantu menyebut Elang Gwern Abwy (Eagle of Gwern Abwy) sebagai hewan tertua (oldest animal) di dunia ini dan yang paling jauh mengembara.
statement.en: In Guest's translation the owl names the Eagle of Gwern Abwy as the oldest animal in this world and the one that has travelled most.

claims.quote: So they went thither, and the eagle said, "Salmon of Llyn Llyw, I have come to thee with an embassy from Arthur

long_description.id: Hainu adalah anjing legenda bersayap dalam cerita Chikugo, Fukuoka. Satu versi menggambarkannya terbang dan melawan pasukan Hideyoshi sebelum dikalahkan.
long_description.en: Hainu is a winged legendary dog in stories of Chikugo, Fukuoka. One version depicts it flying and resisting Hideyoshi's army before being defeated.

long_description.id: Versi lain menjadikannya anak anjing kesayangan Hideyoshi yang mati di tempat itu. Nama Hainuzuka dikaitkan dengan makam anjing itu dan masih dipakai sebagai nama tempat. Makamnya dikatakan berada di kompleks Sōgakuji dengan prasasti 'makam anjing'. Pemerintah Chikugo menjelaskan bahwa Hanemaru dibuat dari legenda Hainu.
long_description.en: Another version makes it Hideyoshi's beloved puppy that dies there. The name Hainuzuka is associated with the dog's burial mound and remains a place name. Its mound is said to stand at Sōgakuji with an inscription meaning 'dog mound'. Chikugo City explains that Hanemaru is based on the Hainu legend.

short_description.id: Finngálkn adalah makhluk dongeng Nordik dan Islandia, campuran manusia di bagian atas dan hewan di bagian bawah seperti kentaur, yang dalam tradisi kemudian berarti hewan buas hasil kawin kucing dan rubah.
short_description.en: The Finngálkn is a fabulous beast of Norse and Icelandic lore, human above and animal below like a centaur, which in later tradition meant a fierce offspring of a cat and a fox.

long_description.id: Finngálkn adalah makhluk ajaib yang disebut dalam beberapa saga legendaris (fornaldarsögur): sejenis kimera, biasanya campuran manusia dan hewan, manusia di bagian atas dan hewan di bagian bawah, seperti kentaur. Terjemahan Islandia abad ke-12 atas bestiari Physiologus sudah menyamakan finngálkn dengan onocentaurus.
long_description.en: The Finngálkn is a wondrous beast mentioned in several legendary sagas (fornaldarsögur): a kind of chimera, usually a blend of human and animal, human above and beast below, like a centaur. The 12th-century Icelandic translation of the bestiary Physiologus already equates finngálkn with the onocentaur.

long_description.id: Dalam Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis, sang pangeran Hjálmþér terpaksa mencium finngálkn bernama Vargeisa, yang ternyata putri yang terkena sihir; ia berekor dan berkuku kuda, bersurai panjang, bermata terang, bermulut lebar, dan bertangan besar. Dalam Örvar-Odds saga, Grímhildr, ibu Ögmundr, berubah menjadi finngálkn berkepala manusia, bertubuh hewan, bercakar sangat besar, dan berekor raksasa. Njáls saga menceritakan Þorkell hákr yang bertarung lama dan akhirnya membunuh seekor finngálkn.
long_description.en: In Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis, Prince Hjálmþér is forced to kiss the finngálkn Vargeisa, who turns out to be a bewitched princess; she has a horse's tail and hooves, a long mane, bright eyes, a wide mouth and big hands. In Örvar-Odds saga, Grímhildr, Ögmundr's mother, turns into a finngálkn with a human head, an animal body, huge claws and an enormous tail. Njáls saga tells of Þorkell hákr fighting a finngálkn long and finally killing it.

long_description.id: Dalam kumpulan cerita rakyat Jón Árnason, finngálkn adalah hewan hasil kawin kucing dan rubah, sangat buas dan lebih berbahaya bagi domba daripada pemangsa lain, pemalu, sangat cepat, dan hanya bisa ditembak dengan kancing atau peluru perak. Asal kata finngálkn tidak diketahui, tetapi kata itu dikaitkan dengan "campuran yang tak wajar"; pada Abad Pertengahan, Finngálkn juga menjadi nama Nordik untuk rasi Sagitarius.
long_description.en: In Jón Árnason's folktale collection, the finngálkn is the offspring of a cat and a fox, very fierce and more harmful to sheep than any other predator, shy, extremely fast, and able to be shot only with a silver button or silver bullet. The etymology of finngálkn is unknown, but the word is associated with an 'unnatural mixture'; in the Middle Ages Finngálkn was also a Norse name for the constellation Sagittarius.

who.en: Half human, half beast.

did_you_know.en: In the Middle Ages the constellation Sagittarius, pictured as an archer centaur, was also called Finngálkn in Norse.

statement.id: Finngálkn adalah makhluk dongeng, manusia di atas dan hewan di bawah (juga disebut Kentári, kentaur); kata finngálkn juga dipakai untuk keturunan rubah dan kucing.
statement.en: The Finngálkn is a fabulous beast, human above and animal below (also called Kentári, centaur); the word also denotes the offspring of a fox and a cat.

claims.quote: Finngálkn er það dýr kallað, sem köttur og tófa geta saman. Er það grimmt mjög, og öllum vargi skaðlegra fyrir sauðfé manna, og skotharðast allra dýra. Vinnur engin kúla á Finngálknið, og verður það ekki skotið nema með silfurhnapp eða silfurkúlu.

statement.id: Menurut kumpulan cerita Jón Árnason (Þjóðsögum Jóns Árnasonar), finngálkn adalah hewan hasil kawin kucing dan rubah, sangat buas, lebih berbahaya bagi domba daripada pemangsa lain, dan paling sulit ditembak; tak ada peluru yang mempan kecuali kancing atau peluru perak.
statement.en: Per Jón Árnason's folktales (Þjóðsögum Jóns Árnasonar), the finngálkn is the beast a cat and fox beget, very fierce, more harmful to sheep than any other predator and hardest of all to shoot; no bullet works on it but a silver button or bullet.

claims.quote: Finngálkn är ett fabeldjur som omtalas i flera fornaldarsagor. Det rör sig om en chimär; oftast en blandning mellan människa och djur.

statement.id: Finngálkn adalah hewan dongeng yang disebut dalam beberapa saga legendaris (fornaldarsagor), sejenis kimera, biasanya campuran manusia dan hewan.
statement.en: The Finngálkn is a fabulous beast named in several legendary sagas (fornaldarsagor), a chimera, usually a mix of human and animal.

claims.quote: I den isländska översättningen av bestiariet Physiologus, gjord på 1100-talet men endast bevarad i två 1200-talsfragment, sägs finngálkn vara en kentaur

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Islandia (isländska) bestiari Physiologus dari abad ke-12, yang hanya tersisa dalam dua fragmen abad ke-13, finngálkn disebut kentaur (onocentaurus).
statement.en: In the 12th-century Icelandic (isländska) translation of the bestiary Physiologus, surviving only in two 13th-century fragments, finngálkn is said to be a centaur (onocentaurus).

claims.quote: Om Ögmundr Eyþjófsbanis mor Grímhildr sägs i Örvar-Odds saga att hon vid en viss tidpunkt hade förvandlats till finngálkn. Hennes huvud var som en människas, men bakkroppen ett djurs. Hon hade mycket stora klor och en väldig svans.

statement.id: Örvar-Odds saga menyebut Grímhildr, ibu Ögmundr Eyþjófsbani, pernah berubah menjadi finngálkn: kepalanya seperti manusia, tubuh belakangnya hewan, bercakar sangat besar dan berekor raksasa.
statement.en: Örvar-Odds saga says Grímhildr, mother of Ögmundr Eyþjófsbani, once turned into a finngálkn: her head human, her hind body an animal's, with very large claws and a huge tail.

claims.quote: En hona, lystrande till namnet Vargeisa, som tycks ha tillhört ”hästkentaurerna”, omtalas i Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis. ”Hon hade hästsvans, hovar och lång man; ögonen var ljusa, munnen bred och händerna stora.”

statement.id: Dalam Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis disebut finngálkn betina bernama Vargeisa, tampaknya "kentaur kuda": berekor dan berkuku kuda, bersurai panjang, bermata terang, bermulut lebar, bertangan besar.
statement.en: Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis mentions a female named Vargeisa, seemingly a 'horse-centaur': horse's tail and hooves, long mane, bright eyes, wide mouth and large hands.

claims.quote: Etymologin för ordet finngálkn är okänd. Ordet associerar till ”onaturlig blandning”.

statement.id: Etimologi kata finngálkn tidak diketahui; kata itu dikaitkan dengan "campuran yang tak wajar".
statement.en: The etymology of finngálkn is unknown; the word is associated with 'unnatural mixture'.

claims.quote: Under medeltiden var Finngálkn ett norrönt namn på stjärnbilden Sagittarius.

statement.id: Pada Abad Pertengahan, Finngálkn adalah nama Nordik (norrönt) untuk rasi Sagitarius (Sagittarius).
statement.en: In the Middle Ages Finngálkn was a Norse (norrönt) name for the constellation Sagittarius.

claims.quote: Þá mœtti hann finngálkni og varðisk því lengi, en svá lauk með þeim, at hann drap finngálknit.

statement.id: Dalam Njáls saga, Þorkell hákr bertemu finngálkn, lama bertarung dengannya, dan akhirnya membunuhnya.
statement.en: In Njáls saga Þorkell hákr met a finngálkn, fought it long and finally killed it.

claims.quote: Í Hjálmþés sögu og Ölvis neyðist konungssonurinn Hjálmþés til að kyssa finngálknið Vargeisu. Hún reynist þó vera prinsessa í álögum.

statement.id: Dalam Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis, pangeran Hjálmþér terpaksa mencium finngálkn Vargeisa, yang ternyata putri yang terkena sihir.
statement.en: In Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis Prince Hjálmþér is forced to kiss the finngálkn Vargeisa, who proves to be a bewitched princess.

claims.quote: Sagittarius avbildades ofta som en bågskjutande kentaur, varför denna stjärnbild – förutom de mer korrekta benämningarna Bogmaðr eller Skyti – också kom att kallas Finngálkn.

statement.id: Sagitarius sering digambarkan sebagai kentaur pemanah, sehingga rasi ini, selain disebut Bogmaðr atau Skyti, juga dinamai Finngálkn.
statement.en: Sagittarius was often shown as an archer centaur, so the constellation, besides Bogmaðr or Skyti, came to be called Finngálkn.

short_description.id: Trout berbulu adalah makhluk legenda dalam cerita rakyat Amerika dan Islandia: ikan trout yang menumbuhkan bulu tebal untuk menjaga panas tubuh di air yang sangat dingin.
short_description.en: The fur-bearing trout is a legendary creature of American and Icelandic folklore: a trout that grew a thick coat of fur to keep warm in very cold water.

long_description.id: Trout berbulu adalah makhluk legenda dalam cerita rakyat Amerika dan Islandia. Menurut kisahnya, air danau dan sungai tempat ia hidup begitu dingin sehingga ikan ini menumbuhkan bulu tebal untuk menjaga panas tubuhnya; teori lain menyebut empat kendi atau dua botol tonik rambut tumpah ke Sungai Arkansas. Ia konon ditemukan di Sungai Arkansas, Amerika Utara bagian utara, dan Islandia.
long_description.en: The fur-bearing trout is a legendary creature of American and Icelandic folklore. In the tale, the lakes and rivers it lives in are so cold that the fish grew thick fur to keep warm; another version blames four jugs or two bottles of hair tonic spilled into the Arkansas River. It is supposedly found in the Arkansas River, northern North America and Iceland.

long_description.id: Kisah ikan berbulu berasal dari abad ke-17, ketika seorang imigran Skotlandia menulis kepada kerabatnya tentang "hewan dan ikan berbulu" yang berlimpah di Dunia Baru. Terbitan Amerika tertua yang diketahui adalah artikel majalah Montana Wildlife tahun 1929 oleh J.H. Hicken. Sebuah spesimen awetan buatan Ross C. Jobe di Royal Museum of Scotland ternyata trout yang ditempeli bulu kelinci putih.
long_description.en: Tales of furry fish go back to the 17th century, when a Scottish immigrant wrote to relatives of 'furried animals and fish' plentiful in the New World. In America the first known printed account is J.H. Hicken's 1929 piece in Montana Wildlife magazine. A stuffed specimen by Ross C. Jobe at the Royal Museum of Scotland is a trout with white rabbit fur attached.

long_description.id: Dalam legenda Islandia, Loðsilungur adalah trout berbulu ciptaan setan dan raksasa, ikan yang tak bisa dimakan dan memenuhi sungai sebagai hukuman atas kejahatan manusia. Tidak ada spesies trout berbulu yang diketahui, tetapi jamur Saprolegnia dapat membuat ikan tampak berbulu putih.
long_description.en: In Icelandic legend the Loðsilungur is a furry trout created by demons and giants, an inedible fish that overruns rivers as punishment for human wickedness. No fur-bearing trout species is known, but the mould Saprolegnia can make fish look covered in white fur.

short_description.id: Haymon adalah raksasa legenda dari Tirol, pendiri Biara Wilten di Innsbruck, yang menurut cerita membunuh seekor naga dan raksasa Thyrsus.
short_description.en: Haymon is a legendary giant from Tyrol, founder of Wilten Abbey in Innsbruck, who in the tales slew a dragon and the giant Thyrsus.

long_description.id: Haymon adalah tokoh mitis berwujud raksasa dari Tirol. Menurut legenda ia pendiri Biara Wilten di selatan Innsbruck dan penguasa Tirol, hidup antara 600 dan 900 tahun, dan wafat pada tahun 878 di Wilten; makamnya di dekat altar gereja biara Wilten sudah disebut pada abad ke-13. Ia mungkin seorang bangsawan Bayern bernama Haimo.
long_description.en: Haymon is a mythical figure from Tyrol in the form of a giant. Legend makes him the founder of Wilten Abbey south of Innsbruck and ruler of Tyrol, living between 600 and 900 years and dying in 878 at Wilten; his grave by the altar of the Wilten collegiate church is already mentioned in the 13th century. He may have been a Bavarian nobleman named Haimo.

long_description.id: Beberapa tradisi melebur dalam legenda Haymon. Pada abad ke-15 muncul kisah naga penjaga emas di ngarai Sill yang dibunuh Haymon; lidah naga itu, sebenarnya tonjolan tanduk ikan todak berbingkai emas, masih dipamerkan di Museum Negara Tirol Ferdinandeum. Sekitar abad ke-16 muncul kisah pertarungan Haymon melawan raksasa Thyrsus dari daerah Zirl dan Seefeld, yang darahnya konon menjadi minyak batu obat Tirol.
long_description.en: Several traditions merged in the Haymon legend. In the 15th century arose the tale of the gold-guarding dragon of the Sill gorge, slain by Haymon; its tongue, actually the horn extension of a swordfish set in gold, is still shown in the Tyrolean State Museum Ferdinandeum. Around the 16th century came the story of Haymon fighting the giant Thyrsus of the Zirl and Seefeld area, whose blood was said to become the healing Tyrolean shale oil.

long_description.id: Karena menyesal, Haymon memeluk agama Kristen, dibaptis oleh Uskup Chur, mendirikan Biara Wilten, menyerahkannya kepada para biarawan Benediktin dari Tegernsee, dan menjadi bruder hingga wafat. Pada abad ke-17 tafsiran ilmiah menganggap Thyrsus melambangkan orang Retoroman dan Haymon orang Bayern yang datang menghuni lembah Inn. Patung seukuran manusia kedua raksasa itu berdiri di pintu masuk gereja Wilten.
long_description.en: Out of remorse, Haymon took up the Christian faith, was baptised by the Bishop of Chur, founded Wilten Abbey, handed it to Benedictine monks from Tegernsee and became a lay brother until his death. Seventeenth-century scholarly interpretation saw Thyrsus as standing for the Romansh people and Haymon for the Bavarians who settled the Inn valley. Life-size figures of both giants stand at the entrance to the Wilten church.

who.en: The giant founder of Wilten Abbey.

role.en: Slew the dragon of the Sill gorge.

famous_for.en: Defeated the giant Thyrsus.

did_you_know.id: "Lidah naga" yang konon direnggut Haymon, sebenarnya tonjolan tanduk ikan todak berbingkai emas, masih dipamerkan di museum Ferdinandeum Innsbruck.
did_you_know.en: The 'dragon's tongue' Haymon supposedly tore out, actually a swordfish's horn extension set in gold, is still on display at the Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck.

statement.en: Haymon is a mythical giant figure from Tyrol (Austria); he is said to have founded Stift Wilten, a Premonstratensian abbey south of Innsbruck, to have lived between 600 and 900 years ago, and died in 878 AD in Wilten.

claims.quote: Different traditions have been amalgamated in the legend of the giant Haymon.

claims.quote: Im 15. Jahrhundert entstand die lokale Sage von dem goldhütenden Drachen in der Sillschlucht östlich des Bergisel, der von Haymon erschlagen wird. Der Drache könnte für den Fluss Sill stehen, die damals häufig Hochwasser führte. Die Drachenzunge (der Hornfortsatz eines Schwertfisches) wird noch heute, in Gold gefasst, im Tiroler Landesmuseum Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck gezeigt.

statement.id: Pada abad ke-15 muncul legenda lokal tentang naga penjaga emas di ngarai Sill timur Bergisel yang dibunuh Haymon; naga itu mungkin melambangkan Sungai Sill yang sering banjir; lidah naga (tonjolan tanduk ikan todak) berbingkai emas masih dipamerkan di Museum Negara Tirol (Tiroler) Ferdinandeum di Innsbruck.
statement.en: In the 15th century the local legend arose of the gold-guarding dragon in the Sill gorge east of Bergisel, killed by Haymon; the dragon may stand for the often-flooding Sill river; the dragon's tongue (a swordfish's horn extension), set in gold, is still shown in the Tyrolean (Tiroler) State Museum Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck.

claims.quote: Ein zweiter Überlieferungsstrang, der etwa im 16. Jahrhundert aufkommt, lässt Haymon mit dem Riesen Thyrsus, der in der Gegend von Zirl und Seefeld lebte, kämpfen und ihn erschlagen. Aus dessen Thyrsenblut wird das heilkräftige Tiroler Steinöl bzw. Ichthyol gewonnen.

statement.en: A second strand from around the 16th century has Haymon fight and kill the giant Thyrsus of the Zirl and Seefeld area; from Thyrsus's blood the healing Tyrolean shale oil (Steinöl) is said to come.

statement.en: The giant (Riese) Haymon is a legendary figure from Tyrol; legend makes him founder of Wilten monastery south of Innsbruck and ruler of Tyrol.

short_description.id: Himinhrjóðr adalah lembu jantan terbesar milik raksasa Hymir dalam mitologi Nordik, yang kepalanya dipakai Thor sebagai umpan untuk memancing Ular Midgard.
short_description.en: Himinhrjóðr is the greatest ox of the giant Hymir in Norse mythology, whose head Thor used as bait to fish for the Midgard Serpent.

long_description.id: Himinhrjóðr adalah lembu jantan dalam mitologi Nordik, sapi pejantan terbesar dan terindah milik raksasa Hymir. Menurut Snorri Sturluson dalam Gylfaginning, ketika Thor pergi memancing bersama Hymir dan Hymir menyuruhnya mencari umpan sendiri, Thor mengambil lembu terbesar dari kawanan Hymir, mencabut kepalanya, dan membawanya ke pantai.
long_description.en: Himinhrjóðr is an ox of Norse mythology, the largest and finest breeding bull of the giant Hymir. According to Snorri Sturluson's Gylfaginning, when Thor went fishing with Hymir and Hymir told him to find his own bait, Thor took the biggest ox of Hymir's herd, wrenched off its head and carried it to the shore.

long_description.id: Pada kepala lembu itulah Ular Midgard kemudian menggigit kail; namun Hymir begitu ketakutan melihat tangkapan mereka sehingga ia memotong tali pancing, dan ular itu tenggelam kembali ke dasar laut. Kisah memancing Thor juga disebut dalam Hymiskviða dan karya para skald lain, tetapi hanya Snorri yang mencatat nama lembu Hymir.
long_description.en: It was on this ox head that the Midgard Serpent later took the hook; but Hymir was so terrified at the catch that he cut the line, and the serpent sank back into the depths of the sea. Thor's fishing trip is also told in Hymiskviða and by other skalds, but only Snorri records the name of Hymir's ox.

long_description.id: Nama Himinhrjóðr mungkin berarti "perusak langit" bila bagian akhirnya dari kata kerja hrjóða; Finnur Jónsson membayangkan tanduknya begitu tinggi sehingga tampak menembus langit. Varian lain menghasilkan arti seperti "pewarna merah langit" atau "pemecah langit". Rudolf Simek menduga Snorri sendiri yang memberi nama itu, tetapi nama tersebut juga muncul dalam daftar þulur nama lembu.
long_description.en: The name Himinhrjóðr may mean 'sky-destroyer' if its second part comes from the verb hrjóða; Finnur Jónsson imagined its horns so high that they seemed to pierce the sky. Other variants yield meanings such as 'reddener of the sky' or 'sky-breaker'. Rudolf Simek guesses that Snorri himself coined the name, but it also occurs in the þulur lists of ox names.

short_description.id: Ular Bertanduk adalah sosok ular mitos dalam banyak budaya, terutama penduduk asli Amerika, yang dikaitkan dengan air, hujan, petir, dan kelahiran kembali.
short_description.en: The Horned Serpent is a mythical serpent of many cultures, especially Native American, linked with water, rain, lightning and rebirth.

long_description.id: Ular Bertanduk muncul dalam mitologi banyak budaya, termasuk penduduk asli Amerika, Eropa, dan Timur Dekat. Rinciannya berbeda, tetapi banyak kisah mengaitkannya dengan air, hujan, petir, guntur, dan kelahiran kembali. Di Amerika Utara ia menjadi unsur utama Southeastern Ceremonial Complex pada masa prasejarah.
long_description.en: Many cultures, Native American, European and Near Eastern among them, tell of a Horned Serpent. Details differ, but many stories link it with water, rain, lightning, thunder and rebirth. In North American prehistory it was a major element of the Southeastern Ceremonial Complex.

long_description.id: Bagi orang Muscogee, ia ular bawah air bersisik kristal berkilau dengan kristal besar di dahi, yang dihargai untuk meramal; narasumber Jackson Lewis menyebutnya tidak jahat dan tidak mencelakai manusia. Dalam tradisi Iroquois kemarahannya menimbulkan badai di danau, dan orang Mississauga menjauhi gua dekat Danau Ontario yang konon dihuninya.
long_description.en: For the Muscogee it is an underwater serpent with iridescent crystal scales and a large forehead crystal prized for divination; informant Jackson Lewis called it not bad and harmless to people. In Iroquois tradition its anger raises storms on the lakes, and the Mississauga avoided a cave by Lake Ontario said to be its home.

statement.id: Bagi orang Muscogee, Ular Bertanduk adalah ular bawah air bersisik kristal berkilau dengan sebuah kristal besar di dahinya; sisik dan kristalnya dihargai karena kekuatan meramal.
statement.en: For the Muscogee the Horned Serpent is an underwater serpent with iridescent crystal scales and one large crystal on its forehead, both prized for divination.

claims.quote: Jackson Lewis, a Muscogee Creek informant to John R. Swanton, said, "This snake lives in the water has horns like the stag. It is not a bad snake. ... It does not harm human beings but seems to have a magnetic power over game."

statement.id: Jackson Lewis, narasumber Muscogee Creek bagi John R. Swanton, mengatakan ular ini hidup di air, bertanduk seperti rusa, tidak jahat, tidak mencelakai manusia, tetapi seolah punya daya tarik atas hewan buruan.
statement.en: Jackson Lewis, a Muscogee Creek informant to John R. Swanton, said the snake lives in water, has horns like a stag, is not bad and does not harm people, but seems to draw game to it.

claims.quote: イロコイ諸族（現・イロコイ連邦）の伝承では、ホーンド・ サーペントの怒りが湖に嵐を起こすものと考えられていた。

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Iroquois, kemarahan Ular Bertanduk dipercaya menimbulkan badai di danau.
statement.en: In Iroquois tradition the Horned Serpent's anger was thought to raise storms on the lakes.

claims.quote: ミシサグナス族の人々は、オンタリオ湖近くの洞窟にはホーンド・サーペントが棲むために決して近づかなかったという。

statement.id: Orang Mississauga konon tidak pernah mendekati sebuah gua dekat Danau Ontario karena dihuni Ular Bertanduk.
statement.en: The Mississauga reportedly never went near a cave by Lake Ontario because a Horned Serpent lived there.

short_description.id: İsa-Musa quşu adalah mitos dari Azerbaijan tentang dua saudara yang kehilangan sapi jantan yang digembalakannya, menjadi burung, dan terus mencari sambil saling bertanya apakah hewan itu sudah ditemukan.
short_description.en: The İsa-Musa bird is a myth from Azerbaijan about two brothers who lose the oxen they were herding, become birds, and keep searching while asking each other whether the animals have been found.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel pertama, İsa-Musa quşu, yang juga disebut İsaq-Musaq quşu, adalah mitos yang berkaitan dengan burung hantu kecil hutan dan tersebar di kalangan orang Azerbaijan. Mitos ini juga punya versi untuk burung anadil dan untuk burung Yapalaq.
long_description.en: According to the first article, the İsa-Musa bird, also called the İsaq-Musaq bird, is a myth connected with the forest owlet and widespread among Azerbaijanis. The myth also has versions for the anadil birds and for the Yapalaq bird.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah utamanya, dua saudara bernama İsa dan Musa tertidur ketika menggembalakan sapi jantan di padang. Saat terbangun, mereka tidak menemukan hewan-hewan itu. Karena takut kepada majikan yang kejam, mereka memohon kepada Allah agar diubah menjadi burung. Sejak itu keduanya mencari sapi jantan di padang dan saling bertanya apakah sudah ditemukan.
long_description.en: In its main story, two brothers named İsa and Musa fall asleep while herding oxen in the field. On waking, they cannot find the animals. Out of fear of their cruel masters, they pray to Allah to turn them into birds. Since then the two have searched the fields for the oxen and asked each other whether they have been found.

long_description.id: Sumber lain mencatat versi berbeda. Menurut satu riwayat, burung-burung itu mencari İsa dan Musa peyğəmbər dan memanggil kedua nama itu dari senja sampai fajar. Dalam teks yang dikutip artikel jurnal, kedua pemuda memohon kepada Allah agar mengirim seekor burung, dan Allah mengirim seekor burung kepada mereka.
long_description.en: Other sources record different versions. According to one account, the birds search for İsa and Musa the peyğəmbər and call both names from dusk until dawn. In the text quoted by the journal article, the two youths ask Allah to send them a bird, and Allah sends them a bird.

long_description.id: Ungkapan İsa-Musa quşu dipakai secara kiasan untuk orang-orang yang saling mencari. S.Neklyudov menafsirkan perubahan wujud semacam ini sebagai pantulan ruh pada berbagai makhluk, sedangkan artikel jurnal menyebut bahwa pergantian wujud terjadi untuk melewati suatu batas tertentu.
long_description.en: The expression İsa-Musa quşu is used figuratively for people who are searching for one another. S.Neklyudov interprets this kind of transformation as the reflection of the spirit in various beings, while the journal article says a change of form takes place in order to pass a certain limit.

cultural_context.id: Menurut artikel jurnal, dalam kisah semacam ini wujud diubah untuk melewati suatu batas tertentu, dan hal itu dapat dinilai sebagai inisiasi.
cultural_context.en: According to the journal article, in tales of this kind a form is changed in order to pass a certain limit, and this can be regarded as initiation.

statement.id: İsa-Musa quşu (atau İsaq-Musaq quşu) adalah mitos yang berkaitan dengan burung hantu kecil hutan (meşə bayquşcuğu) dan tersebar di kalangan orang Azerbaijan (azərbaycanlılarda).
statement.en: The İsa-Musa bird (or İsaq-Musaq bird) is a myth connected with the forest owlet (meşə bayquşcuğu) and widespread among Azerbaijanis (azərbaycanlılarda).

claims.quote: İsa və Musa adında iki qardaş çöldə öküzlərini ... otararkən yuxuya gedirlər və oyananda heyvanlarını tapa bilmirlər.

statement.id: Dua saudara bernama İsa dan Musa tertidur ketika menggembalakan sapi jantan (atau sapi betina) di padang, dan saat terbangun mereka tidak dapat menemukan hewan-hewan itu.
statement.en: Two brothers named İsa and Musa fall asleep while herding their oxen (or cows) in the field, and on waking they cannot find their animals.

claims.quote: Əzazil ağalarının ... qorxusundan Allaha yalvarıb quşa çevrilmələrini istəyirlər.

statement.id: Karena takut kepada majikan mereka yang kejam (atau ibu tiri mereka), keduanya memohon kepada Allah agar diubah menjadi burung.
statement.en: Out of fear of their cruel masters (or stepmothers), they pray to Allah to turn them into birds.

claims.quote: O zamandan bəri qardaşlar çöllərdə öküzləri axtarır və bir-birlərinə deyirlər

statement.id: Sejak saat itu kedua saudara mencari sapi jantan di padang dan saling berkata (deyirlər) satu sama lain.
statement.en: Since then the brothers have searched the fields for the oxen and said (deyirlər) to each other.

claims.quote: Mifin anadil quşları və Yapalaq quşu üçün versiyaları da vardır.

statement.id: Mitos ini juga punya versi untuk burung anadil dan burung Yapalaq.
statement.en: The myth also has versions for the anadil birds and the Yapalaq bird.

claims.quote: Digər bir rəvayətə görə quşlar İsa və Musa peyğəmbəri axtarırlar. Hava qaralandan səhər açılana kimi onlar İsa və Musa deyib çağırırlar.

statement.id: Menurut riwayat lain, burung-burung itu mencari İsa dan Musa peyğəmbər (nabi); dari senja sampai fajar mereka memanggil İsa dan Musa.
statement.en: According to another account, the birds search for İsa and Musa the peyğəmbər (prophet); from dusk until dawn they call out İsa and Musa.

claims.quote: Bu ifadə məcazi mənada bir-birini axtaran insanlar üçün istifadə edilir.

statement.id: Ungkapan itu dipakai secara kiasan (məcazi) untuk orang-orang yang saling mencari.
statement.en: The expression is used figuratively (məcazi) for people who are searching for one another.

claims.quote: S.Neklyudov bu cür çevrilməni ruhun müxtəlif varlıqlar üzərində əks olunması kimi izah edir.

statement.id: S.Neklyudov menjelaskan perubahan wujud semacam ini sebagai pantulan ruh pada berbagai makhluk (varlıqlar).
statement.en: S.Neklyudov explains this kind of transformation as the reflection of the spirit in various beings (varlıqlar).

claims.quote: İki oğlan cüt sürürmüş, biri İsa adında, biri də Musa adında.

statement.id: Teks rakyat ini bercerita tentang dua anak lelaki yang membajak (cüt sürürmüş), seorang bernama İsa dan seorang lagi bernama Musa.
statement.en: The folk text tells of two boys ploughing (cüt sürürmüş), one named İsa and the other named Musa.

claims.quote: Allah bunları quşa döndərir. Bunlar başlayıllar öküzləri axtarmağa. Həmişə də bir-birindən soruşurlar ki, tapdın?

statement.id: Allah mengubah mereka menjadi burung; mereka mulai mencari sapi jantan dan selalu bertanya satu sama lain apakah sudah ditemukan (tapdın).
statement.en: Allah turns them into birds; they begin to search for the oxen and always ask each other whether they have found them (tapdın).

claims.quote: Azerbaycan-Türk efsane ve masallarında kuş donundan insan donuna veya perilerin güvercin donuna girme olayları vardır

statement.id: Dalam legenda dan dongeng Azerbaycan-Türk (efsane ve masal) ada peristiwa pergantian wujud antara burung dan manusia, atau peri menjadi merpati; kisah dua pemuda bernama İsa dan Musa dikutip sebagai contoh.
statement.en: In Azerbaijani-Turkic legends and tales (efsane ve masal) there are cases of changing between bird form and human form, or of fairies taking dove form; the tale of two youths named İsa and Musa is cited as an example.

claims.quote: Allaha yalvararak kendilerine bir kuş göndermesini istemişler. Allah bunlara bir kuş göndermiş.

statement.id: Dalam versi yang dikutip artikel jurnal, kedua pemuda memohon kepada Allah agar mengirim seekor burung, dan Allah mengirim seekor burung (bir kuş) kepada mereka.
statement.en: In the version quoted in the journal article, the two youths ask Allah to send them a bird, and Allah sends them a bird (bir kuş).

claims.quote: Buradan görüldüğü gibi belli bir sınırı aşmak için don değiştirilir veya dönüşüm olayı gerçekleşir. Bunu inisiyasyon olarak da değerlendirmek mümkündür.

statement.id: Menurut artikel jurnal, perubahan wujud terjadi untuk melewati suatu batas tertentu (belli bir sınır), dan hal ini dapat dinilai sebagai inisiasi (inisiyasyon).
statement.en: According to the journal article, a change of form takes place in order to pass a certain limit (belli bir sınır), and this can also be regarded as initiation (inisiyasyon).

claims.quote: Ögey analarının öküzünü itirən qardaşların Yapalaq quşuna çevrilməsi ilə bağlı mif

statement.id: Ada mitos tentang dua saudara yang kehilangan sapi jantan ibu tiri mereka (ögey analarının) lalu berubah menjadi burung Yapalaq.
statement.en: There is a myth about brothers who lose their stepmother's (ögey analarının) ox and turn into the Yapalaq bird.

topic.en: How the two figures come to be birds

summary.en: According to the first article and the folk text, the two brothers pray to Allah and are turned into birds.

summary.en: According to the text quoted in the journal article, Allah sends a bird to the two youths.

short_description.id: Grimalkin adalah kucing peri dalam legenda Skotlandia yang tinggal di dataran tinggi; nama ini juga istilah kuno untuk kucing.
short_description.en: In Scottish legend the grimalkin is a fairy cat living in the Highlands; the word is also an old term for a cat.

long_description.id: Grimalkin, juga greymalkin, adalah istilah kuno untuk kucing, dari kata "grey" (kelabu) ditambah "malkin", kata kuno yang berasal dari bentuk panggilan sayang untuk nama perempuan Maud. Legenda Skotlandia menyebut grimalkin sebagai kucing peri yang tinggal di dataran tinggi (Highlands). Artikel fy menambahkan bahwa kisah rakyat tentang kucing semacam ini setidaknya berasal dari Abad Pertengahan.
long_description.en: Grimalkin, or greymalkin, is an old word for a cat, built from 'grey' and 'malkin', an archaic word derived from a pet form of the woman's name Maud. Scottish legend treats the grimalkin as a fairy cat of the Highlands. The fy article adds that folk stories about such cats go back at least to the Middle Ages.

long_description.id: Pada masa modern awal, nama grimalkin, dan kucing pada umumnya, dikaitkan dengan iblis dan sihir; perempuan yang diadili sebagai penyihir pada abad ke-16 hingga ke-18 sering dituduh memiliki familiar, kerap seekor grimalkin. Dalam Macbeth karya Shakespeare, Babak 1 Adegan 1, Penyihir Pertama berseru "I come, Graymalkin" kepada familiarnya.
long_description.en: In the early modern era the name, and cats generally, came to be tied to the devil and witchcraft; women tried as witches between the 16th and 18th centuries were often charged with keeping a familiar, frequently a grimalkin. In Shakespeare's Macbeth, Act 1, Scene 1, the First Witch calls out to her familiar, 'I come, Graymalkin'.

short_description.id: Lehen adalah ular laut raksasa mitologi Basque yang dikaitkan dengan pesisir, dan dalam karya Agosti Xaho tampil sebagai Lehen-Suge berkepala tujuh.
short_description.en: Lehen is a giant sea serpent of Basque mythology tied to the coast, which appears in Agosti Xaho's work as the seven-headed Lehen-Suge.

long_description.id: Lehen, "pertama" dalam bahasa Basque, adalah ular laut raksasa mitologi Basque yang dikaitkan dengan pesisir, meski keterangan tentangnya sedikit; dahulu anak-anak desa pesisir mengaku melihatnya dari tebing. Dalam Azti-begia (1834), Agosti Xaho menggambarkan Lehen-Suge sebagai ular raksasa berkepala tujuh yang terkait kedalaman bumi dan asal-usul dunia, gambaran yang bukan sekadar ular laut.
long_description.en: Lehen, Basque for 'first', is a giant sea serpent of Basque mythology linked with the coast, though little is known of it; coastal children once claimed to see it from the cliffs. In Azti-begia (1834) Agosti Xaho describes Lehen-Suge as a seven-headed giant serpent tied to the depths of the earth and the world's origins, an image beyond a mere sea serpent.

long_description.id: Ia kadang disamakan dengan naga Herensuge; Julio Caro Baroja menduga keduanya berasal-usul sama, sementara artikel bahasa Basque menganggap keduanya makhluk berbeda.
long_description.en: It is sometimes confused with the dragon Herensuge; Julio Caro Baroja thinks they may share an origin, while the Basque article treats them as different beings.

claims.quote: Figure associée au serpent primordial dans la tradition littéraire basque, il apparaît notamment sous la forme Lehen-Suge dans l'œuvre d'Agosti Xaho. Son principal témoignage littéraire connu se trouve dans Azti-begia, publié en 1834, où Xaho décrit Lehen-Suge comme un serpent gigantesque et monstrueux associé aux profondeurs de la terre et à une cosmologie des origines.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi sastra Basque ia dikaitkan dengan ular purba, terutama sebagai Lehen-Suge dalam karya Agosti Xaho; kesaksian utamanya ada dalam Azti-begia (1834), yang menggambarkan Lehen-Suge sebagai ular raksasa mengerikan yang terkait kedalaman bumi dan kosmologi asal-usul.
statement.en: In Basque literary tradition it is linked with the primordial serpent, notably as Lehen-Suge in the work of Agosti Xaho; its main literary witness is Azti-begia (1834), where Xaho describes Lehen-Suge as a gigantic monstrous serpent tied to the depths of the earth and a cosmology of origins.

short_description.id: Lurikeen adalah lutin dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, roh pendamping para tinker; dalam kisah Kildare ia digambarkan sebagai tukang sepatu kecil yang menipu gadis penangkapnya agar lepas.
short_description.en: The Lurikeen is a lutin of Irish folklore and familiar spirit of tinkers; in the Kildare tale he is shown as a tiny cobbler who tricks his captor girl into letting him go.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, Lurikeen adalah lutin (peri kecil) sekaligus roh pendamping para tinker, yaitu tukang kaleng keliling, dan dikaitkan dengan kesengsaraan serta kekalahan. Kisah paling jelas tentangnya dalam sumber kedua berasal dari Kildare.
long_description.en: In Irish folklore the Lurikeen is a lutin, a small sprite, and the familiar spirit of tinkers, the itinerant tinsmiths, and is linked with misery and defeats. The clearest tale about him in the second source comes from Kildare.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Kildare, seorang gadis bernama Breedheen menemukan Lurikeen bekerja memperbaiki sepatu kecil di bawah pohon tua. Ia berpakaian topi bersudut tiga berhias renda emas dan celana selutut, dengan kendi bir dan pipa, dan begitu asyik menyanyikan balada Irlandia sampai tidak menyadari gadis itu menangkap tengkuknya.
long_description.en: In the Kildare tale a girl called Breedheen finds the Lurikeen mending a tiny shoe under an old tree. He wears a three-cornered hat with gold lace and knee-breeches, with a beer jug and a pipe, and is so absorbed in singing an Irish ballad that he fails to notice the girl seizing him by the scruff.

long_description.id: Gadis itu menuntut uang dan menolak melepaskannya. Di puncak bukit, Lurikeen berteriak seolah Castle Carberry terbakar; ketika gadis itu menoleh ke kastil, ia kehilangan bobotnya di tangannya dan makhluk itu menghilang seakan mimpi.
long_description.en: The girl demands his money and will not let go. At the brow of a hill the Lurikeen screams as if Castle Carberry were on fire; when she looks toward the castle, the weight in her hands is gone and he has vanished as if it had been a dream.

long_description.id: Satu kisah Wexford hanya sedikit berbeda: Molly mengawasi Lurikeen sampai ia menunjuk batang booliaun bui tempat harta terkubur, tetapi ketika Molly kembali membawa sekop, seluruh tempat sudah dipenuhi booliaun.
long_description.en: A Wexford tale differs only slightly: Molly watches the Lurikeen until he points out the booliaun bui stalk where treasure lies, but when she returns with spades, the whole place is thick with booliauns.
