short_description.id: Manananggal adalah makhluk dalam cerita rakyat Filipina yang dapat melepaskan tubuh bagian atasnya dari bagian bawah, lalu terbang dengan sayap seperti kelelawar pada malam hari untuk mencari mangsa.
short_description.en: The manananggal is a creature of Philippine folklore that can detach its upper body from its lower half and fly at night on bat-like wings in search of prey.

long_description.id: Manananggal adalah makhluk mitos dari cerita rakyat Filipina yang mampu memisahkan tubuh bagian atasnya dari bagian bawah. Taring dan sayapnya membuatnya tampak seperti vampir. Dalam cerita rakyat, makhluk ini biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan yang, setelah memisahkan diri, memperlihatkan isi perutnya dan menumbuhkan sayap besar mirip kelelawar untuk terbang mencari korban di malam hari.
long_description.en: The manananggal is a mythical creature of Philippine folklore able to separate its upper body from its lower half. Its fangs and wings give it a vampire-like look. In folklore it is usually portrayed as female; once separated, it reveals its entrails and grows large bat-like wings to fly in search of victims at night.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini dipercaya memangsa perempuan hamil yang sedang tidur, menggunakan lidah panjang seperti belalai untuk mengisap janin atau darah. Cerita rakyat juga mengaitkannya dengan pengantin baru, pasangan kekasih, dan bayi yang baru lahir. Selama berburu, tubuh bagian bawahnya diam tak bergerak dan menjadi titik lemahnya: garam, bawang putih, abu, atau api yang ditaburkan padanya mencegah tubuh atas bersatu kembali, dan bila tidak bersatu sebelum matahari terbit, makhluk itu dipercaya mati.
long_description.en: It is believed to prey on sleeping pregnant women, using a long proboscis-like tongue to draw out fetuses or blood. Folklore also links it with newlyweds, lovers and newborns. While it hunts, its lower half stays motionless and is its weak point: salt, garlic, ash or fire applied to it keep the upper body from rejoining, and if the two do not reunite before sunrise the creature is believed to die.

long_description.id: Mitos manananggal dikenal luas di wilayah Visayas, terutama di Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol, dan Antique. Seperti aswang, manananggal dipercaya dapat diusir dengan bawang putih, garam, dan air suci, dan dikatakan menghindari belati, cahaya, cuka, rempah, serta ekor ikan pari. Makhluk serupa juga dikenal di Indonesia dan Malaysia.
long_description.en: The manananggal myth is widely known in the Visayas, especially Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol and Antique. Like aswangs, manananggals are believed to be repelled by garlic, salt and holy water, and are said to avoid daggers, light, vinegar, spices and a stingray's tail. Similar figures are found in Indonesia and Malaysia.

long_description.id: Catatan tertua berasal dari biarawan Juan de Plasencia pada tahun 1589, yang menulis tentang magtatangal, sosok yang menampakkan diri pada malam hari tanpa kepala atau isi perut di Catanduanes. Plasencia menganggapnya dongeng, meski penduduk mengaku pernah melihatnya. Kamus bahasa Tagalog karya Domingo de los Santos (1703) menjelaskan bahwa nama itu berasal dari tangal, yang berarti melepaskan, karena makhluk itu terbang hanya dengan separuh tubuhnya.
long_description.en: The oldest record comes from the friar Juan de Plasencia in 1589, who wrote of the magtatangal, a figure that showed itself at night without its head or entrails in Catanduanes. Plasencia considered it a fable, though the locals said they had seen it. Domingo de los Santos's Tagalog dictionary (1703) explains that the name comes from tangal, meaning to disengage, because the creature flies with only half its body.

long_description.id: Manananggal menjadi tokoh penting dalam film horor Filipina. Film Manananggal (1927) karya José Nepomuceno adalah film horor Filipina pertama. Segmen Manananggal dalam Shake, Rattle & Roll (1984) garapan Peque Gallaga menjadi segmen paling populer dalam waralaba itu.
long_description.en: The manananggal became a key figure in Filipino horror film. Manananggal (1927) by José Nepomuceno was the first Filipino horror film. The Manananggal segment of Shake, Rattle & Roll (1984), directed by Peque Gallaga, became the franchise's most popular segment.

cultural_context.id: Kepercayaan pada manananggal pernah diduga menjadi penjelasan atas keguguran mendadak pada masa Filipina kuno.
cultural_context.en: Belief in the manananggal has been hypothesized as an explanation for sudden miscarriages in ancient Philippines.

claims.quote: In Philippine folklore, the manananggal is typically portrayed as a fearsome and grotesque creature, most often depicted as female. It is known to separate its upper body from its lower half, revealing its entrails and developing large, bat-like wings that allow it to fly at night in search of victims.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, manananggal biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk menyeramkan, paling sering perempuan, yang memisahkan tubuh atasnya, memperlihatkan isi perut, dan menumbuhkan sayap besar mirip kelelawar untuk terbang mencari korban di malam hari.
statement.en: In Philippine folklore the manananggal is usually a fearsome creature, most often female, that separates its upper body, revealing its entrails, and grows large bat-like wings to fly at night in search of victims.

claims.quote: The manananggal is commonly believed to prey on sleeping, pregnant women by using an elongated, proboscis-like tongue to extract fetuses or draw blood.

statement.id: Manananggal dipercaya memangsa perempuan hamil yang tidur dengan lidah panjang seperti belalai untuk mengisap janin atau darah.
statement.en: The manananggal is believed to prey on sleeping pregnant women with a long proboscis-like tongue to extract fetuses or draw blood.

claims.quote: Folklore also associates the creature with targeting newlyweds, lovers, newborn children, and occasionally grooms who were abandoned after marriage. During its nocturnal hunt, the creature's severed lower torso remains motionless and is its point of vulnerability. Traditional practices for killing a manananggal include applying salt, garlic, ash, or fire to the lower half

statement.id: Cerita rakyat juga mengaitkannya dengan pengantin baru, kekasih, dan bayi; saat berburu, tubuh bawahnya diam dan menjadi titik lemah, dan cara membunuhnya antara lain menaburkan garam, bawang putih, abu, atau api pada tubuh bawah itu.
statement.en: Folklore also links it with newlyweds, lovers and newborns; while it hunts, its lower torso stays motionless and is its weak point, and it is killed by applying salt, garlic, ash or fire to that lower half.

claims.quote: The myth of the manananggal is widely recognized in the Visayan regions of the Philippines, particularly in the western provinces of Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol, and Antique.

statement.id: Mitos manananggal dikenal luas di wilayah Visayas, terutama di Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol, dan Antique.
statement.en: The manananggal myth is widely known in the Visayas, especially Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol and Antique.

claims.quote: as manananggals are also believed to be repelled by garlic, salt, and holy water. They are also thought to avoid daggers, light, vinegar, spices and the tail of a stingray, which can be fashioned into a whip.

statement.id: Manananggal dipercaya dapat diusir dengan bawang putih, garam, dan air suci, dan menghindari belati, cahaya, cuka, rempah, serta ekor ikan pari.
statement.en: Manananggals are believed to be repelled by garlic, salt and holy water, and to avoid daggers, light, vinegar, spices and a stingray's tail.

claims.quote: Comparable mythical figures appear in neighboring Southeast Asian cultures, including those of Indonesia and Malaysia.

statement.id: Sosok mitos serupa muncul di budaya Asia Tenggara lain, termasuk Indonesia dan Malaysia.
statement.en: Comparable mythical figures appear in neighbouring Southeast Asian cultures, including Indonesia and Malaysia.

claims.quote: The seventh was called magtatangal, and his purpose was to show himself at night to many persons, without his head or entrails.
claims.locator: Customs of the Tagalogs, daftar pelayan iblis

statement.id: Plasencia mencatat magtatangal, yang menampakkan diri pada malam hari kepada banyak orang tanpa kepala atau isi perut.
statement.en: Plasencia recorded the magtatangal, which showed itself at night to many people without its head or entrails.

claims.quote: They say that it flies and eats human flesh, but when it flies, it only has half its body, and that is why it is called that because it's tangal which means that it can disengage
claims.locator: Historical accounts (Fray Domingo de los Santos, Vocabulario de Lengua Tagala, 1703)

statement.id: Kamus Domingo de los Santos (1703) menulis bahwa magtatangal terbang dan memakan daging manusia hanya dengan separuh tubuhnya, sehingga dinamai dari tangal, 'melepaskan'.
statement.en: Domingo de los Santos's dictionary (1703) says the magtatangal flies and eats human flesh with only half its body, hence its name from tangal, 'to disengage'.

claims.quote: This seems to me to be a fable, although the natives affirm that they have seen it, because the devil probably caused them so to believe. This occurred in Catanduanes.

statement.id: Plasencia menganggapnya dongeng, meski penduduk mengaku melihatnya; ini terjadi di Catanduanes.
statement.en: Plasencia thought it a fable, though locals said they had seen it; this occurred in Catanduanes.

statement.en: That description is from Fray Domingo de los Santos, Vocabulario de Lengua Tagala (1703).

claims.locator: Appearances in film and other media

statement.en: Manananggal (1927), directed by José Nepomuceno, was the first Filipino horror film, a silent film with Mary Walter as the manananggal.

statement.en: In 1984 Regal Films released the first Shake, Rattle & Roll, and its Manananggal segment became the franchise's most popular.

claims.quote: His grandmother tasks him to kill this creature by locating the lower half and preventing it from re-attaching.

statement.en: In the segment, his grandmother tasks Douglas with killing the creature by finding its lower half and stopping it from reattaching.

claims.quote: If it fails to recombine before sunrise, the creature is believed to die.

statement.id: Bila tidak bersatu kembali sebelum matahari terbit, makhluk itu dipercaya mati.
statement.en: If it fails to recombine before sunrise, the creature is believed to die.

claims.quote: It was hypothesized to explained sudden ... in ancient Philippines.

statement.id: Manananggal pernah diduga menjadi penjelasan atas keguguran mendadak di Filipina kuno.
statement.en: The manananggal was hypothesized to explain sudden miscarriages in ancient Philippines.

claims.quote: — Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589)

statement.id: Catatan tentang magtatangal berasal dari Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).
statement.en: The magtatangal account is from Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).

claims.quote: it is generally associated with characteristics similar to those found in other folkloric beings such as vampires, Visayan folklore entities, and aswangs

statement.id: Manananggal umumnya dikaitkan dengan ciri yang mirip makhluk folklor lain seperti vampir, makhluk folklor Visayas, dan aswang.
statement.en: The manananggal is generally associated with traits similar to other folkloric beings such as vampires, Visayan entities and aswangs.

text.id: Namanya tercatat sejak karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM
text.en: His name is attested from Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC

short_description.id: Mikhael adalah malaikat agung yang dihormati dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam; ia dipandang sebagai pejuang Tuhan dan pelindung umat-Nya.
short_description.en: Michael is an archangel honoured in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, regarded as the warrior of God and a protector of God's people.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, Mikhael diyakini sebagai malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan, dan sebagian tradisi Kristen juga menghormatinya sebagai orang kudus. Penyebutan namanya yang tertua yang masih ada berasal dari karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menempatkannya sebagai pemimpin para malaikat. Kitab Henokh mendaftarnya sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung.
long_description.en: In Jewish, Christian, and Islamic tradition, Michael is believed to be an archangel and the warrior of God, and some Christian traditions also venerate him as a saint. The oldest surviving mentions of his name come from Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC, which present him as chief of the angels. The Book of Enoch lists him as one of seven archangels.

long_description.id: Kitab Daniel menyebut Mikhael sebagai salah satu pemimpin utama yang datang menolong, dan sebagai pemimpin agung yang akan bangkit membela umat Daniel. Berdasarkan ayat-ayat ini, tulisan Yahudi awal dan Kitab Henokh menyebutnya pemimpin Israel, sedangkan tulisan Yahudi yang lebih kemudian menyebutnya pembela orang Yahudi. Karena peran itu, ia juga digambarkan sebagai malaikat kesabaran dan belas kasihan. Dalam Haggadah, ia ditampilkan sebagai malaikat agung yang paling menonjol.
long_description.en: The Book of Daniel calls Michael one of the chief princes who came to help, and the great prince who will stand up for Daniel's people. On the basis of these verses, early Jewish writings and the Book of Enoch call him the prince of Israel, while later Jewish writings call him the advocate of the Jews. Because of this role he is also described as the angel of forbearance and mercy. In the Haggadah he appears as the most prominent of the archangels.

long_description.id: Dalam Perjanjian Baru, Kitab Wahyu mengisahkan perang di surga ketika Mikhael dan para malaikatnya melawan naga, yang kemudian dicampakkan ke bumi. Surat Yudas menyebut Mikhael sang malaikat agung berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa. Menurut Ensiklopedia Katolik, tradisi Kristen memberinya tugas melawan Satan, menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman terutama pada saat kematian, dan menjadi pembela umat Tuhan.
long_description.en: In the New Testament, the Book of Revelation tells of a war in heaven in which Michael and his angels fight the dragon, which is then cast out into the earth. The Epistle of Jude speaks of Michael the archangel disputing with the devil over the body of Moses. According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives him the offices of fighting Satan, rescuing the souls of the faithful especially at the hour of death, and championing God's people.

long_description.id: Dalam Islam, Mikhael (Mīkāʾīl) adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung dan sering dipasangkan dengan Jibril. Literatur Islam mengaitkannya dengan rahmat, dengan permohonan ampun bagi manusia, serta dengan gejala alam dan turunnya hujan. Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, ia jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
long_description.en: In Islam, Michael (Mīkāʾīl) is one of the four archangels and is often paired with Gabriel. Islamic literature associates him with mercy, with asking forgiveness for humans, and with natural phenomena and rain. Unlike in Christian tradition, he is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Kristen, Mikhael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak. Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal. Para pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepadanya, dan di Frigia ia terutama dikenal sebagai penyembuh.
long_description.en: Christian art shows Michael as a fully armed angelic warrior with helmet, sword, and shield, standing above the dragon and at times driving a lance into it. He is also shown with scales used to weigh the souls of the dead. Early Christians entrusted the care of the sick to him, and in Phrygia he was known above all as a healer.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Ensiklopedia Katolik, tradisi Kristen memberi Mikhael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan, menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman pada saat kematian, dan menjadi pembela umat Tuhan, sehingga ia dijadikan pelindung Gereja.
cultural_context.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting Satan, rescuing the souls of the faithful at the hour of death, and championing God's people, so that he became the patron of the Church.

who.id: Mikhael adalah malaikat agung yang dipandang sebagai pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, maupun Islam.
who.en: Michael is an archangel regarded as God's warrior in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam alike.

origin.id: Namanya pertama tercatat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM.
origin.en: His name first appears in Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC.

role.id: Ia diyakini sebagai pelindung Israel dan pembela umat Tuhan.
role.en: He is believed to be the guardian of Israel and the champion of God's people.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena memimpin para malaikat melawan naga dalam perang di surga menurut Kitab Wahyu.
famous_for.en: He is best known for leading the angels against the dragon in the war in heaven described in Revelation.

did_you_know.id: Liturgi Yunani menyebut Mikhael Archistrategos, yang berarti "panglima tertinggi".
did_you_know.en: The Greek liturgy calls Michael Archistrategos, meaning "highest general".

description.id: Para pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Mikhael, dan di Frigia ia dihormati terutama sebagai penyembuh.
description.en: Early Christians entrusted the care of the sick to Michael, and in Phrygia he was honoured above all as a healer.

role.en: Leader of the angels

summary.id: Mikhael dan para malaikatnya berperang melawan naga dan malaikat-malaikatnya; naga besar yang disebut Iblis dan Satan itu dicampakkan ke bumi.
summary.en: Michael and his angels fight the dragon and its angels; the great dragon, called the Devil and Satan, is cast out into the earth.

title.en: The dispute over the body of Moses

role.en: Opponent of the devil in the dispute

summary.id: Menurut Surat Yudas, Mikhael berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa, tetapi tidak menghujatnya dan hanya berkata, "The Lord rebuke thee."
summary.en: According to Jude, Michael disputed with the devil about the body of Moses but did not bring a railing accusation against him, saying only, "The Lord rebuke thee."

role.en: Helper

summary.id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, pemimpin kerajaan Persia menghalangi utusan yang datang kepada Daniel, sampai Mikhael, salah satu pemimpin utama, datang menolong.
summary.en: In the Book of Daniel, the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstands the messenger sent to Daniel until Michael, one of the chief princes, comes to help.

description.en: Renowned sanctuary of Michael linked to the account of his apparition in the Roman Breviary.

description.id: Nama Mikhael muncul dalam karya-karya Yahudi dari abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM.
description.en: Michael's name appears in Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC.

description.id: Penampakan Mikhael di tempat sucinya di Monte Gargano menurut Brevir Romawi.

note.en: In Revelation, the dragon fought by Michael is called the Devil and Satan.

note.id: Menurut tulisan Yahudi, permusuhan Mikhael dengan Samael bermula ketika Samael dicampakkan dari surga.
note.en: According to Jewish writings, Michael's enmity with Samael began when Samael was thrown down from heaven.

note.id: Dalam Islam, Mikhael sering dipasangkan dengan Jibril sebagai sesama malaikat agung.
note.en: In Islam, Michael is often paired with Gabriel as a fellow archangel.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa peran Mikhael sebagai pejuang lebih menonjol dalam tradisi Kristen daripada dalam tradisi Islam?
learning_questions.en: Why might Michael's role as a warrior be more prominent in Christian tradition than in Islamic tradition?

learning_questions.id: Apa persamaan dan perbedaan gambaran Mikhael dalam Kitab Daniel dan Kitab Wahyu?
learning_questions.en: What are the similarities and differences between Michael's portrayal in Daniel and in Revelation?

claims.quote: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam while additionally being venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

statement.id: Michael, juga disebut Archangel Michael atau Michael the Taxiarch, adalah malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, dan dihormati sebagai orang kudus dalam sebagian tradisi Kristen.
statement.en: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, and is venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

claims.quote: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, often but not always apocalyptic, where he is the chief of the angels and archangels

statement.id: Penyebutan nama Michael tertua yang masih ada terdapat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menyebutnya pemimpin para malaikat dan malaikat agung.
statement.en: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, where he is chief of the angels and archangels.

claims.quote: he is the guardian prince of ancient Israel and is responsible for the care of the Israelites

statement.id: Ia adalah pangeran pelindung Israel kuno dan bertanggung jawab memelihara bangsa Israel.
statement.en: He is the guardian prince of ancient Israel, responsible for the care of the Israelites.

claims.quote: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels (the remaining names are Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel)

statement.id: Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch) mendaftar Michael sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung, bersama Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, dan Remiel.
statement.en: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels, with Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel.

claims.quote: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel, with whom he is often paired), ʾIsrāfīl (trumpeter angel) and ʿAzrāʾīl (angel of death).

statement.id: Dalam Islam, Michael atau Mīkāʾīl adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung bersama Jibril (Gabriel), yang sering dipasangkan dengannya, Israfil, dan Azrail.
statement.en: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel), with whom he is often paired, Israfil, and Azrail.

claims.quote: In further Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy. He asks God for forgiveness for humans

statement.id: Dalam literatur Islam, Michael dikaitkan dengan rahmat dan memohon ampun kepada Tuhan bagi manusia.
statement.en: In Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy and asks God for forgiveness for humans.

claims.quote: As the angel to effectuate God's providence he is also associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

statement.id: Sebagai malaikat pelaksana pemeliharaan Tuhan, ia dikaitkan dengan gejala alam dan menurunkan hujan ke daratan.
statement.en: As the angel who carries out God's providence, he is associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

claims.quote: Unlike Christian tradition, Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior-angel

statement.id: Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, dalam Islam Michael jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
statement.en: Unlike in Christian tradition, in Islam Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.

claims.quote: (Hebrew "Who is like God?"). St. Michael is one of the principal angels; his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle fought in heaven against the enemy and his followers.

statement.id: Nama Michael dalam bahasa Ibrani berarti "Who is like God?" (Siapa yang seperti Allah?); ia salah satu malaikat utama, dan namanya menjadi seruan perang para malaikat baik dalam pertempuran di surga.
statement.en: The Hebrew name Michael means "Who is like God?"; he is one of the principal angels, and his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle in heaven.

claims.quote: Following these Scriptural passages, Christian tradition gives to St. Michael four offices: To fight against Satan. To rescue the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

statement.id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia (Ensiklopedia Katolik), tradisi Kristen memberi Michael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan dan menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman dari kuasa musuh, terutama pada saat kematian.
statement.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting against Satan and rescuing the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

claims.quote: To be the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law, the Christians in the New Testament; therefore he was the patron of the Church

statement.id: Michael adalah pembela umat Tuhan, orang Yahudi dalam Hukum Lama dan orang Kristen dalam Perjanjian Baru, sehingga ia menjadi pelindung Gereja.
statement.en: Michael is the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law and the Christians in the New Testament, and therefore the patron of the Church.

claims.quote: In art St. Michael is represented as an angelic warrior, fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield (often the shield bears the Latin inscription: Quis ut Deus), standing over the dragon, whom he sometimes pierces with a lance.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak.
statement.en: In art, Michael is represented as an angelic warrior fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield, standing over the dragon, which he sometimes pierces with a lance.

claims.quote: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed

statement.id: Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal.
statement.en: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed.

claims.quote: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general"

statement.id: Liturgi Yunani menyebutnya Archistrategos, "panglima tertinggi" (highest general).
statement.en: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general".

claims.quote: In Normandy St. Michael is the patron of mariners in his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

statement.id: Di Normandia, Michael adalah pelindung para pelaut di tempat sucinya yang terkenal di Mont-Saint-Michel, Keuskupan Coutances.
statement.en: In Normandy, Michael is the patron of mariners at his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

claims.quote: Well known is the apparition of St. Michael (a. 494 or 530-40), as related in the Roman Breviary, 8 May, at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano

statement.id: Terkenal kisah penampakan Michael (tahun 494 atau 530-40) di tempat sucinya yang termasyhur di Monte Gargano, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam Brevir Romawi (Roman Breviary).
statement.en: Well known is the apparition of Michael (a. 494 or 530-40) at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano, as related in the Roman Breviary.

claims.quote: but to St. Michael they gave the care of their sick. At the place where he was first venerated, in Phrygia, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his interposition in military affairs.

statement.id: Pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Michael; di Frigia (Phrygia), tempat ia pertama dihormati, kemasyhurannya sebagai penyembuh malaikat mengalahkan perannya dalam urusan militer.

short_description.id: Okesa neko (おけさ猫, "Okesa si kucing") adalah tokoh legenda Jepang tentang seekor bakeneko yang menjelma geisha muda cantik dan bernyanyi untuk melunasi utang bekas pemiliknya.
short_description.en: Okesa neko (おけさ猫, "Okesa the cat") is a figure of Japanese legend: a bakeneko who became a pretty young geisha and sang to pay off her former owner's debts.

long_description.id: Okesa neko adalah tokoh legenda dalam cerita rakyat Jepang (japanischen Folklore) tentang seekor Bakeneko yang, sebagai geisha muda yang cantik, berkeliling Jepang sambil bernyanyi dan bermain musik untuk melunasi utang bekas pemiliknya. Legenda tertua berasal dari provinsi Sado: di pulau Sado tinggal seorang nenek pencinta kucing yang memelihara puluhan kucing, tetapi ketika hartanya habis kucing-kucing itu pergi satu per satu, hingga kucing kesayangannya pun lenyap.
long_description.en: Okesa neko is a figure of Japanese folklore (japanischen Folklore): a Bakeneko who, as a pretty young geisha, travelled through Japan singing and playing music to pay off her former owner's debts. The oldest legend comes from Sado province: on the island of Sado lived an old woman who kept dozens of cats, but when her money ran out they left one by one, until even her favourite disappeared.

long_description.id: Suatu pagi seorang gadis cantik datang mengetuk pintu; kimononya berpola dan berwarna persis seperti bulu kucing kesayangan si nenek. Gadis itu memperkenalkan diri sebagai Okesa dan berjanji mengembalikan harta si nenek. Di Edo ia menjadi geisha yang begitu indah suaranya hingga burung pun terdiam karena iri. Namun seorang kapten kapal memergokinya dalam wujud kucing raksasa yang memakan kepala ikan; Okesa mengancamnya agar tutup mulut, dan ketika ia membocorkan rahasia itu, Okesa dalam wujud kucing raksasa mencelupkannya berulang kali ke air lalu membawanya pergi.
long_description.en: One morning a pretty girl knocked at the door; her kimono had exactly the pattern and colour of the old woman's favourite cat's fur. The girl introduced herself as Okesa and promised to win back the old woman's money. In Edo she became a geisha whose singing was so beautiful that even the birds fell silent with envy. But a ship's captain caught her as a giant cat eating fish heads; Okesa threatened him to keep quiet, and when he let the secret slip, Okesa in giant cat form dunked him repeatedly in the water and carried him off.

long_description.id: Nama Okesa berasal dari aliran musik Okesa bushi yang muncul pada awal zaman Edo dan berasal dari pulau Sado; kisah ini juga dikenal sebagai "Geisha penyanyi dari Sado" dan masuk ke teater Nō. Okesa yang baik hati tidak biasa bagi Bakeneko, yang umumnya digambarkan licik dan pendendam, sehingga sebagian folkloris menduga ia terilhami oleh Maneki-neko yang membawa keberuntungan.
long_description.en: The name Okesa comes from the Okesa bushi style of music, which arose early in the Edo period and originated on Sado island; the tale is also known as "The singing geisha of Sado" and even entered Nō theatre. A kind-hearted Okesa is unusual for a Bakeneko, usually described as treacherous and vengeful, so some folklorists suspect she was inspired by the lucky Maneki-neko.

short_description.id: Zuzidun Txakurra adalah roh anjing bercahaya dalam mitologi Basque yang muncul setelah kematian sebagai tanda jiwa yang terkutuk dan menuntut utangnya dibayar.
short_description.en: Zuzidun Txakurra is a glowing dog spirit of Basque mythology that appears after a death as a sign of a cursed soul seeking to settle its debts.

long_description.id: Zuzidun Txakurra, "anjing obor", adalah roh mitologi Basque yang muncul sebagai anjing dengan obor menyala di moncongnya. Bila ia muncul setelah seseorang meninggal, jiwa orang itu terkutuk; arwah seperti ini menuntut ganti rugi atas kesalahan semasa hidup. Legenda ini khas Barakaldo, dan Resurrección María de Azkue mencatat bahwa legenda ini hampir punah.
long_description.en: Zuzidun Txakurra, 'the dog of the torch', is a Basque spirit that appears as a dog with a burning torch in its muzzle. If it appears after someone's death, that person's soul is cursed; such souls demand reparation for wrongs done in life. The legend belongs to Barakaldo, and Resurrección María de Azkue noted it was nearly extinct.

long_description.id: Di Barakaldo anjing itu besar, hitam, dengan api di mata dan rahangnya, dan selalu lari lalu lenyap ke dalam air, bahkan ember kecil. Seorang warga menjebaknya dengan lauburu yang digambar mengelilingi rumah tanpa ada air; anjing itu mengaku arwah tetangga yang mati sebelum mengembalikan barang curian, dan baru tenang setelah warga itu berjanji membayar utangnya.
long_description.en: In Barakaldo the dog was huge and black with fire in its eyes and jaws, always fleeing and vanishing into water, even a small bucket. One villager trapped it with a lauburu drawn around a house with no water; the dog confessed to being the spirit of a neighbour who died before returning stolen goods, and found peace when the villager promised to pay the debt.

who.en: A glowing dog spirit.

role.en: Marks a cursed soul.

famous_for.en: The torch in its muzzle.

summary.en: A villager traps the dog with a lauburu; it confesses to being a neighbour's soul who stole from his father, and departs once the debt is promised.

statement.en: In legend, if Zuzidun Txakurra appears after someone's death, it is a sign that the dead person's soul is cursed; the legend belongs to the Barakaldo area, though Resurrección María de Azkue recorded it at Otxandio, noting it was about to disappear.

claims.quote: Celles-ci apparaissent aux vivants sous la forme d'un chien lumineux demandant réparation ou restitution pour le tort fait dans leur vie et/ou lors la célébration de messes pour leur âme.

statement.id: Arwah itu muncul kepada orang hidup sebagai anjing bercahaya yang menuntut ganti rugi atas kesalahan semasa hidupnya atau misa bagi jiwanya.
statement.en: These souls appear to the living as a glowing dog demanding reparation for wrongs done in life or Masses for their soul.

claims.quote: Immense, noir et avec du feu dans ses yeux et dans ses mâchoires. Beaucoup ont surpris le txakurra qui traînait autour des maisons, mais ils n'ont jamais pu l'attraper.

statement.id: Di Barakaldo anjing itu digambarkan besar, hitam, dengan api di mata dan rahangnya; banyak yang melihatnya berkeliaran di sekitar rumah tetapi tak pernah bisa menangkapnya.
statement.en: In Barakaldo it was described as huge and black with fire in its eyes and jaws; many saw it prowling around houses but none could catch it.

claims.quote: Il a toujours fui jusqu'à ce qu'il plonge dans n'importe quel endroit avec de l'eau, un puits, un étang et même dans un petit seau, puis disparaissait.

statement.id: Ia selalu lari lalu terjun ke tempat berair, entah sumur, kolam, atau ember kecil, dan menghilang.
statement.en: It always fled until it plunged into any water, a well, a pond or even a small bucket, and vanished.

claims.quote: il dessina un lauburu autour de la maison, marquant le sol avec une houe. Puis il s'assura qu'il n'y ait pas de flaque d'eau ou de récipient contenant de l'eau, et attendit.

statement.id: Seorang warga Barakaldo menggambar lauburu mengelilingi rumahnya dengan cangkul dan menyingkirkan semua genangan dan wadah air, lalu menunggu anjing itu.
statement.en: A Barakaldo villager drew a lauburu around his house with a hoe, removed every puddle and container of water, and waited for the dog.

claims.quote: « Je suis l'esprit de ton voisin qui est mort sans retourner les biens que j'ai volés à ton père. Et je ne peux pas sortir autrement jusqu’à ce que quelqu’un paie ma dette. »

statement.id: Terkurung di dalam lauburu, anjing itu berkata: "Aku arwah tetanggamu yang mati tanpa mengembalikan barang yang kucuri dari ayahmu, dan aku tak bisa keluar sampai ada yang membayar utangku."
statement.en: Trapped inside the lauburu, the dog said: 'I am the spirit of your neighbour, who died without returning what I stole from your father, and I cannot leave until someone pays my debt.'

claims.quote: Jasotako kondairen arabera, dirudienez, pertsona bat hil ondoren Zuzidun Txakurra agertzen bada hildakoaren arima madarikatua dagoen seinalea da.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Basque juga mencatat bahwa kemunculan Zuzidun Txakurra setelah kematian seseorang menandakan jiwa orang itu terkutuk.
statement.en: The Basque article also records that Zuzidun Txakurra appearing after someone's death signals that the dead person's soul is cursed.

short_description.id: Roggenwolf ("serigala gandum hitam") adalah setan gandum berwujud serigala dalam legenda Jerman, roh angin di ladang yang ditakuti sebagai pemangsa anak-anak.
short_description.en: The Roggenwolf ('rye wolf') is a wolf-shaped corn demon of German legend, a wind spirit of the fields feared as a devourer of children.

long_description.id: Roggenwolf adalah setan gandum berwujud serigala dan momok anak-anak dalam legenda Jerman, yang tinggal di ladang. Peribahasa abad ke-19 menggambarkannya rakus tak terpuaskan hingga tak bisa bergerak karena kekenyangan, serta agresif; ia melolong dan meraung karena lapar.
long_description.en: The Roggenwolf is a wolf-shaped corn demon and children's bogey of German legend that dwells in the fields. Nineteenth-century proverbs paint it as insatiably greedy, gorging itself until it cannot move, and aggressive; it howls and roars in its hunger.

long_description.id: Ia juga roh angin, sehingga disebut Windwolf: bila angin menggerakkan bulir gandum bergelombang, orang berkata serigala sedang melintasi ladang. Ia dianggap menyuburkan atau sebaliknya merugikan ladang, karena memakan gandumnya, dan konon menyebabkan penyakit ergot pada gandum yang karena itu disebut Wolf atau Wolfszahn. Ia bersembunyi di berkas panen terakhir, yang juga disebut Wolf, dan siapa pun yang bersentuhan dengannya saat panen jatuh sakit.
long_description.en: It is also a wind spirit, hence the name Windwolf: when the wind sets the ears of grain waving, people said the wolf was going through the field. It was thought either to promote or to reduce the field's fertility, since it feeds on the grain, and is said to cause ergot, which is therefore called Wolf or Wolfszahn. It sits in the last sheaf of the harvest, also called Wolf, and anyone who touches it at harvest falls ill.

long_description.id: Sebagai momok anak-anak, ia menunggu anak-anak yang mencari bunga jagung atau memetik bulir gandum untuk mencabik, menggigit, memakan, atau membawa mereka pergi; jiwa anak yang dimakannya harus melayang di pepohonan sampai panen selesai. Para Roggenwolf dianggap anak Roggenmuhme. Wilhelm Mannhardt membandingkannya dengan serigala Nordik Fenrir, karena keduanya diikat, kadang dengan besi.
long_description.en: As a children's bogey it lies in wait for children looking for cornflowers or picking ears of grain, to tear, bite, devour or carry them off; the souls of children it has eaten must fly about in the trees until the grain is brought in. The Roggenwölfe are held to be the children of the Roggenmuhme. Wilhelm Mannhardt compared it with the Norse wolf Fenrir, since both are bound, sometimes with iron.

role.en: Waving grain marks its passing.

famous_for.en: Seizes children in the fields.

did_you_know.en: When the wind set the grain waving, people used to say the wolf was going through the field.

description.id: Menimbulkan lolongan angin dan menjelma udara kasar, kabut, dan hujan.
description.en: Causes the howling of the wind and embodies rough air, fog and rain.

claims.quote: Der Roggenwolf ist ein wolfsgestaltiger Korndämon und Kinderschreck der deutschen Sage, der sich im Feld und Acker aufhält. Verschiedene Sprichwörter des 19. Jahrhunderts charakterisieren den Roggenwolf als unersättlich und gefräßig bis hin zur Bewegungsunfähigkeit als Folge des unmäßigen Schlingens. Auch ist er aggressiv. Der Roggenwolf heult und brüllt in seiner Gier nach Futter.

statement.id: Roggenwolf adalah setan gandum (Korndämon) berwujud serigala dan momok anak-anak dalam legenda Jerman (deutschen), tinggal di ladang; peribahasa abad ke-19 menggambarkannya rakus tak terpuaskan hingga tak bisa bergerak karena kekenyangan, agresif, dan melolong serta meraung karena lapar.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf is a wolf-shaped corn demon (Korndämon) and children's bogey of German (deutschen) legend dwelling in fields; 19th-century proverbs call it insatiable and gluttonous to the point of immobility, aggressive, howling and roaring in its hunger.

claims.quote: Der Roggenwolf ist ein Windgeist. Er trägt davon auch den Namen Windwolf. Besonders, wenn der Wind die Getreideähren in wellenförmige Bewegung bringt, hieß es, der Wolf gehe durch oder über das Korn, sei im Korn oder jage die Schafe im Korn.

statement.id: Roggenwolf adalah roh angin, sehingga disebut Windwolf; terutama ketika angin membuat bulir gandum bergelombang, orang berkata serigala berjalan melintasi gandum.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf is a wind spirit, hence called Windwolf; especially when the wind sets the ears waving, it was said the wolf was going through the corn.

claims.quote: Er soll auch das Mutterkorn verursachen, welches nach ihm Wolf oder Wolfszahn genannt wird. In der letzten Erntegarbe soll der Roggenwolf sitzen. Nach ihm wird auch die letzte Garbe als Wolf bezeichnet. Wer bei der Ernte mit dem Roggenwolf in Kontakt kommt, wird davon krank.

statement.id: Ia konon menyebabkan ergot (Mutterkorn), yang karenanya disebut Wolf atau Wolfszahn; ia duduk di berkas panen terakhir, yang juga disebut Wolf, dan siapa pun yang bersentuhan dengannya saat panen jatuh sakit.
statement.en: It is said to cause ergot (Mutterkorn), therefore called Wolf or Wolfszahn; it sits in the last harvest sheaf, also called Wolf, and whoever touches it at harvest falls ill.

claims.quote: Dem Treiben des Roggenwolfes im Feld wird entweder die Eigenschaft zugesprochen, dass es die Fruchtbarkeit des Feldes fördere oder gegenteilig, dass es die Fruchtbarkeit des Feldes verringere, zumal der Roggenwolf sich vom Korn des Feldes ernährt.

statement.id: Kegiatan Roggenwolf di ladang dianggap menyuburkan ladang, atau sebaliknya mengurangi kesuburannya, apalagi karena ia memakan gandumnya.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf's activity in the field was thought either to boost its fertility or, conversely, to reduce it, especially as it feeds on the grain.

claims.quote: Neben Roggenwolf (Roggenwulf) sind dies die Namensformen Getreidewolf, Kornwolf (großer Kornwolf, Kürnwolf, Koorwolf, Koanwolf, Körwolp), Haferwolf (Hawerwolf), Gerstenwolf, Kartoffelwolf (Kantüffelwolf), Graswolf (Grasewolf), Erbswolf und Pflaumenwolf (Plummenwolf).

statement.id: Selain Roggenwolf, nama lainnya mengikuti tanaman ladangnya: Getreidewolf, Kornwolf, Haferwolf, Gerstenwolf, Kartoffelwolf, Graswolf, Erbswolf, dan Pflaumenwolf.
statement.en: Besides Roggenwolf, its names follow the crop: Getreidewolf, Kornwolf, Haferwolf, Gerstenwolf, Kartoffelwolf, Graswolf, Erbswolf and Pflaumenwolf.

claims.quote: Er soll im Feld auf die Kornblumen suchenden oder Ähren pflückenden Kinder warten, um sie zu zerreißen, zu beißen, zu packen, zu fressen oder fortzutragen. Die Seelen der vom Roggenwolf gefressenen Kinder müssen auf den Bäumen umherfliegen, bis das Korn eingefahren wird. Die Roggenwölfe gelten als Kinder der ebenfalls im Kornfeld hausenden Roggenmuhme, eines anderen Kinderschrecks.

statement.id: Roggenwolf menunggu di ladang anak-anak yang mencari bunga jagung (Kornblumen) atau memetik bulir untuk mencabik, menggigit, memakan, atau membawa mereka pergi; jiwa anak yang dimakannya harus melayang di pepohonan sampai panen dibawa masuk; para Roggenwölfe dianggap anak Roggenmuhme, momok lain di ladang.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf waits in the field for children seeking cornflowers (Kornblumen) or picking ears, to tear, bite, seize, devour or carry them off; the souls of children it ate must fly about the trees until the grain is in; the Roggenwölfe are held to be children of the Roggenmuhme, another field bogey.

claims.quote: Roggenwolf, německy „žitný vlk“, též Roggenhund (žitný pes), je polní duch v německém folklóru. Číhá v obilí a dáví nepozorné rolníky a děti jsou varovány, že jím budou roztrhány, když půjdou do pole.

statement.id: Roggenwolf ("serigala gandum hitam"), juga Roggenhund, adalah roh ladang dalam cerita rakyat Jerman (německém); ia mengintai di gandum dan mencekik petani yang lengah, dan anak-anak diperingatkan akan dicabiknya bila masuk ladang.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf ('rye wolf'), also Roggenhund, is a field spirit of German (německém) folklore; it lurks in the grain and strangles careless farmers, and children are warned it will tear them apart if they go into the field.

claims.quote: Die Funktion des Roggenwolfs als Kinderschreck wird durch die Namen Gelbzahn und Speilzahn verdeutlicht.

statement.id: Fungsi Roggenwolf sebagai momok anak diperjelas oleh nama Gelbzahn ("gigi kuning") dan Speilzahn.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf's role as a children's bogey is shown by the names Gelbzahn ('yellow tooth') and Speilzahn.

claims.quote: Folklorista Wilhelm Mannhardt srovnal Roggenwolfa se severským Fenrim. Oba vlci jsou spoutáni, někdy i s pomocí železa

statement.id: Folklorist Wilhelm Mannhardt membandingkan Roggenwolf dengan Fenrir Nordik (severským Fenrim); kedua serigala itu diikat, kadang dengan besi.
statement.en: Folklorist Wilhelm Mannhardt compared the Roggenwolf with the Norse Fenrir (severským Fenrim); both wolves are bound, sometimes with iron.

claims.quote: Das Heulen des Windes soll durch den Roggenwolf hervorgerufen werden. Der Roggenwolf tritt auch als Verkörperung der rauen Luft, des Nebels und des Regens auf.

statement.id: Lolongan angin konon ditimbulkan Roggenwolf; ia juga tampil sebagai penjelmaan udara kasar, kabut, dan hujan.
statement.en: The howling of the wind is said to be caused by the Roggenwolf; it also appears as the embodiment of rough air, fog and rain.

statement.en: The Roggenwolf ('rye wolf'), also Roggenhund, is a field spirit of German (německém) folklore; it lurks in the grain and strangles careless farmers, and children are warned it will tear them apart if they go into the field.

claims.quote: Die Funktion des Roggenwolfs als Kinderschreck wird durch die Namen Gelbzahn und Speilzahn verdeutlicht.

statement.id: Fungsi Roggenwolf sebagai momok anak diperjelas oleh nama Gelbzahn ("gigi kuning") dan Speilzahn.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf's role as a children's bogey is shown by the names Gelbzahn ('yellow tooth') and Speilzahn.

claims.quote: Folklorista Wilhelm Mannhardt srovnal Roggenwolfa se severským Fenrim. Oba vlci jsou spoutáni, někdy i s pomocí železa

statement.id: Folklorist Wilhelm Mannhardt membandingkan Roggenwolf dengan Fenrir Nordik (severským Fenrim); kedua serigala itu diikat, kadang dengan besi.
statement.en: Folklorist Wilhelm Mannhardt compared the Roggenwolf with the Norse Fenrir (severským Fenrim); both wolves are bound, sometimes with iron.

claims.quote: Das Heulen des Windes soll durch den Roggenwolf hervorgerufen werden. Der Roggenwolf tritt auch als Verkörperung der rauen Luft, des Nebels und des Regens auf.

statement.id: Lolongan angin konon ditimbulkan Roggenwolf; ia juga tampil sebagai penjelmaan udara kasar, kabut, dan hujan.
statement.en: The howling of the wind is said to be caused by the Roggenwolf; it also appears as the embodiment of rough air, fog and rain.

short_description.id: Svetovit atau Svantovit adalah dewa kelimpahan dan perang, dewa tertinggi suku Slavia Rani dan kemudian seluruh Slavia Polabia, dengan pusat pemujaan di Tanjung Arkona, Rügen.
short_description.en: Svetovit, or Svantovit, is the god of abundance and war, chief god of the Slavic Rani tribe and later of all the Polabian Slavs, worshipped at Cape Arkona on Rügen.

long_description.id: Svetovit, yang juga dikenal sebagai Sventovit atau Svantovit, adalah dewa kelimpahan dan perang. Ia dewa tertinggi suku Rani, lalu seluruh Slavia Polabia, dan juga pemberi orakel; satu sumber membandingkannya dengan Perun, dewa tertinggi suku-suku Slavia lain, dan banyak ahli memandangnya sebagai perwujudan Perun di kalangan Polabia. Pemujaannya yang terorganisasi berpusat di pulau Rügen, di Tanjung Arkona, tempat kuil utamanya berdiri.
long_description.en: Svetovit, also called Sventovit or Svantovit, is a god of abundance and war. He was the supreme god of the Rani tribe and later of all the Polabian Slavs, and a giver of oracles; one source compares him with Perun, the highest god of other Slavic tribes, and many scholars see him as a Polabian form of Perun. His organised worship had its centre at Cape Arkona on Rügen, the site of his chief temple.

long_description.id: Menurut para penulis kronik abad pertengahan, patungnya berkepala empat serta memegang tanduk dan pedang. Satu sumber menyebut patung kayu di Arkona itu bermuka empat dengan tanduk berisi anggur, berdiri dalam kuil persegi bertiang di dalam Jaromarsburg; tiap kepala menghadap satu arah mata angin yang masing-masing punya warna sendiri. Kuda putih, pelana, tali kekang, panji, dan burung elang dipersembahkan kepadanya.
long_description.en: Medieval chroniclers describe his statue as four-headed, holding a horn and a sword. One source says the wooden statue at Arkona had four faces and a horn filled with wine, and stood in a square pillared temple inside the Jaromarsburg; each head faced one cardinal direction, each with its own colour. A white horse, a saddle, a bit, a banner and eagles were dedicated to him.

long_description.id: Sekali setahun, setelah panen, diadakan perayaan besar untuknya. Para pendeta meramal dengan tanduk dan kuda milik sang dewa, dan dipercaya bahwa pada malam hari dewa itu sendiri menunggang kuda untuk melawan musuh-musuhnya. Orakel Svantovit menerima banyak hadiah dan persembahan dari dunia Slavia maupun tetangganya. Tempat suci itu dianggap pusat rohani bangsa Slavia, terutama suku Rani, hingga dihancurkan pada tahun 1168 oleh orang Denmark di bawah Uskup Absalon dan Raja Valdemar.
long_description.en: Once a year, after the harvest, a great festival was held for him. Priests divined with the god's horn and horse, and the god himself was believed to ride out at night against his enemies. The Svantovit oracle received many gifts and offerings from the Slavic world and its neighbours. The sanctuary was seen as the spiritual centre of the Slavs, especially the Rani, until the Danes under Bishop Absalon and King Valdemar destroyed it in 1168.

long_description.id: Namanya dapat diartikan "Tuan yang Kuat" atau "Tuan yang Suci". Pandangan yang dominan menyatakan bahwa kata *svętъ semula berarti "kuat" dan baru bermakna "suci" karena pengaruh Kristen, tetapi kini sebagian ahli menganggap makna "suci" sebagai makna asli. Dahulu orang keliru mengira kultus Svetovit berasal dari Santo Vitus, sedangkan bacaan Światowid, "dewa yang melihat empat penjuru dunia", adalah ciptaan kaum Romantik Polandia abad ke-19 dan dinilai keliru sama sekali.
long_description.en: His name can be rendered "Strong Lord" or "Holy Lord". The prevailing view holds that *svętъ first meant "strong" and only gained the sense "holy" under Christian influence, but some scholars now treat "holy" as the original meaning. It was once wrongly believed that his cult derived from St. Vitus, and the reading Światowid, "god seeing the four directions of the world", was an invention of 19th-century Polish Romantics and is judged entirely wrong.

statement.en: Svantovit (also Svantevit, Swantewit, Sventevit, Svetovit, Svatovit, Świętowit, Svątevit, Suvid or Святовит) is a Slavic deity: war god, oracle giver and supreme god of the Rani on Rügen and other Elbe and Baltic Slavs, comparable to Perun among other Slavic tribes.

short_description.id: Uchchaihshravas adalah kuda terbang berkepala tujuh yang muncul dari pengadukan samudra dalam Hindu.
short_description.en: Uchchaihshravas is a seven headed flying horse emerging from Hindu ocean churning.

long_description.id: Uchchaihshravas adalah kuda terbang berkepala tujuh yang muncul dari pengadukan samudra dalam Hindu. Ia digambarkan putih seperti salju dan sebagai raja kuda.
long_description.en: Uchchaihshravas is a seven headed flying horse emerging from Hindu ocean churning. He is depicted as snowy white and king of horses.

long_description.id: Ia disebut tunggangan Indra, tetapi juga kuda Bali raja asura. Warna ekornya menjadi pokok taruhan Vinata dan Kadru; para putra ular Kadru membuat ekor tampak hitam. Bhagavad Gita 10.27 menyebutnya sebagai kuda yang lahir dari amrita. Terjemahan Mahabharata Ganguli menyebut Uchchaihsravas kuda ilahi yang selalu muda.
long_description.en: He is called Indra's mount but also the horse of Bali, king of asuras. His tail's color is the subject of Vinata and Kadru's wager; Kadru's serpent sons make the tail appear black. Bhagavad Gita 10.27 mentions him as the horse born from amrita. Ganguli's Mahabharata translation calls Uchchaihsravas a divine steed that is perpetually young.

short_description.id: Víðópnir adalah burung mitologis Nordik, digambarkan sebagai ayam jantan, yang bertengger di puncak pohon dunia Mímameiðr atau Yggdrasil.
short_description.en: Víðópnir is a bird of Norse mythology, described as a rooster perched at the top of the world tree Mímameiðr or Yggdrasil.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Víðópnir adalah burung yang menghuni puncak pohon dunia Yggdrasil, kadang ditempatkan di kening burung kosmis lain. Menurut puisi Edda Fjölsvinnsmál, Víðópnir atau Víðófnir adalah ayam jantan di mahkota pohon dunia, kadang digambarkan sebagai elang alap, yang duduk di antara kedua mata elang kosmis Hræsvelgr di puncak Mímameiðr, pohon yang dianggap sama dengan Yggdrasil.
long_description.en: In Norse mythology Víðópnir is a bird living at the top of the world tree Yggdrasil, sometimes placed on the brow of another cosmic bird. According to the eddic poem Fjölsvinnsmál, Víðópnir or Víðófnir is a rooster in the crown of the world tree, at times pictured as a falcon, perched between the eyes of Hræsvelgr, the cosmic eagle, on top of Mímameiðr, a tree taken to be the same as Yggdrasil.

long_description.id: Ia berwarna keemasan dan bersinar seperti badai petir, menjaga keutuhan pohon dunia dan menjadi momok bagi raksasa Surt dan raksasa perempuan Sinmara. Ia hanya dapat dibunuh dengan senjata Lævateinn yang dijaga Sinmara, tetapi Sinmara hanya meminjamkannya kepada orang yang membawakan bulu ekor Víðópnir, sebuah tugas yang tampaknya mustahil.
long_description.en: He is golden and shines like a thunderstorm, guarding the integrity of the world tree and terrifying the giant Surt and the giantess Sinmara. He can only be killed with the weapon Lævateinn, which Sinmara keeps, yet she lends it only to someone who first brings her a tail feather of Víðópnir, a seemingly impossible task.

long_description.id: Karl Joseph Simrock menafsirkan namanya sebagai Windofnir, "penenun angin". Jacob Grimm membandingkan ayam di pohon ini dengan ayam di tiang Mei dan ayam angin di menara gereja, dan menduga para misionaris Kristen mengambil alih simbol kafir itu.
long_description.en: Karl Joseph Simrock read the name as Windofnir, 'wind-weaver'. Jacob Grimm compared the rooster on the tree with the cock on maypoles and the weathercock on church towers, and suggested Christian missionaries took over the heathen symbol.

short_description.id: Yale adalah binatang mitis mirip antelop bertaring babi hutan dengan tanduk yang dapat diputar ke segala arah, dari Plinius Tua dan heraldik Eropa.
short_description.en: The yale is a mythical antelope-like beast with boar's tusks and horns that swivel in any direction, from Pliny the Elder and European heraldry.

long_description.id: Yale atau centicore adalah binatang mitis mirip antelop atau kambing bertaring babi hutan, yang tanduk besarnya dapat diputar ke segala arah: satu dijulurkan untuk bertarung, yang lain disimpan sebagai cadangan. Plinius Tua menggambarkan eale dari Aethiopia sebesar kuda nil dan berekor gajah, mungkin dari antelop atau kerbau Afrika. Namanya mungkin dari kata Ibrani yael, "ibex".
long_description.en: The yale or centicore is a mythical antelope- or goat-like beast with boar's tusks whose great horns swivel in any direction: one forward to fight, the other held in reserve. Pliny the Elder described the eale of Aethiopia as hippo-sized with an elephant's tail, perhaps from African antelope or buffalo. Its name may come from the Hebrew yael, 'ibex'.

long_description.id: Dalam bestiari abad pertengahan basilisk adalah musuhnya, dan dalam heraldik ia melambangkan pertahanan yang kuat; yale menjadi binatang heraldik Wangsa Beaufort dan keluarga kerajaan Britania sejak Henry VII sekitar 1485.
long_description.en: In medieval bestiaries the basilisk is its enemy, and in heraldry it stands for strong defence; the yale became a heraldic beast of the House of Beaufort and the British royal family from Henry VII around 1485.

who.en: A beast with swivelling horns.

famous_for.en: Heraldic beast of the House of Beaufort.

note.id: Musuhnya menurut bestiari.

short_description.id: Aswang adalah sebutan umum dalam cerita rakyat Filipina untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud, seperti vampir, penyihir, pemakan mayat, dan manusia yang menjelma binatang.
short_description.en: Aswang is a general term in Filipino folklore for a range of evil shape-shifting creatures, such as vampires, witches, corpse-eaters and humans who turn into beasts.

long_description.id: Aswang adalah istilah umum untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, mulai dari vampir, pemakan mayat, penyihir, pengisap isi perut, sampai manusia yang menjelma anjing, kucing, atau babi. Makhluk ini dikenal di seluruh Filipina, terutama di Luzon selatan, sebagian Mindanao dan Visayas, khususnya Provinsi Capiz. Penjajah Spanyol mencatat bahwa aswang adalah makhluk mitos yang paling ditakuti di Filipina sejak abad ke-16. Tiap daerah punya tafsiran sendiri, sehingga ada ratusan versi aswang di seluruh negeri.
long_description.en: Aswang is a general term for many evil shape-shifting creatures of Filipino folklore, from vampires, ghouls, witches and viscera suckers to humans who become dogs, cats or pigs. It is known throughout the Philippines, especially southern Luzon, parts of Mindanao and the Visayas, above all the province of Capiz. Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared mythical creature of the Philippines as early as the 16th century. Each community has its own interpretation, leaving hundreds of versions across the country.

long_description.id: Peneliti folklor Maximo Ramos membagi aswang ke dalam lima golongan: vampir, pengisap isi perut yang memisahkan tubuhnya, weredog, penyihir, dan pemakan mayat. Aswang vampir tampil sebagai perempuan cantik dan mengisap darah dengan lidah seperti belalai. Pengisap isi perut, atau manananggal, pada siang hari berwujud perempuan menarik, tetapi pada malam hari menumbuhkan sayap, meninggalkan tubuh bagian bawahnya, lalu terbang mencari mangsa, terutama janin di kandungan. Buku Ramos membagi makhluk folklor Filipina ke dalam dua belas golongan, dan aswang muncul di lima di antaranya.
long_description.en: Folklorist Maximo Ramos grouped the aswang into five groups: vampires, viscera suckers that split their bodies, weredogs, witches and ghouls. The vampire aswang appears as a beautiful woman and sucks blood with a proboscis-like tongue. The viscera sucker, or manananggal, looks like an attractive woman by day, but at night grows wings, leaves its lower body behind and flies in search of victims, especially unborn children. Ramos’s book sorts Filipino folkloric creatures into twelve categories, and the aswang appears in five of them.

long_description.id: Weredog menyusup ke desa sebagai pengembara, lalu sekitar tengah malam berubah menjadi anjing, kucing, atau babi dan memangsa manusia. Aswang penyihir sangat pendendam dan mengutuk korbannya dengan membuat benda seperti beras, tulang, atau serangga keluar dari lubang tubuh. Aswang pemakan mayat memakan jenazah dan berkumpul di pohon dekat kuburan untuk menggali makam yang masih baru.
long_description.en: The weredog enters villages as a traveller and around midnight turns into a dog, cat or pig and preys on people. Witch aswangs are extremely vindictive and curse victims by making objects such as rice, bones or insects come out of their bodily orifices. Ghoul aswangs eat corpses and gather in trees near cemeteries to dig up fresh burials.

long_description.id: Aswang biasanya berkeliaran pada malam hari di kuburan dan hutan, karena kekuatannya berkurang atau hilang pada siang hari, tetapi mereka juga bisa hidup di dalam desa. Mereka takut cahaya, sehingga rumah duka dulu dibuat terang agar aswang tidak datang mencuri jenazah. Perilakunya yang jahat dapat dibaca sebagai kebalikan nilai tradisional Filipina: aswang tidak segan memangsa kerabatnya sendiri.
long_description.en: Aswangs usually roam at night in cemeteries and woods, since their powers are reduced or lost by day, yet they can also live inside villages. They fear light, so wakes were brightly lit to keep aswangs from stealing the corpse. Their evil behaviour can be read as a reversal of traditional Filipino values: aswangs do not hesitate to prey on their own kin.

long_description.id: Ada banyak cara penangkal aswang, antara lain benda suci, rempah, garam, abu, ekor ikan pari, cuka, sirih pinang, dan air seni. Minyak khusus anti-aswang dipercaya mendidih bila aswang berada di dekatnya, dan aswang yang menyamar dapat dikenali dari bayangan yang terbalik di matanya.
long_description.en: There are many protections against aswangs, including holy objects, spices, salt, ash, a stingray's tail, vinegar, betel chew and urine. A special anti-aswang oil is believed to boil when an aswang is near, and a disguised aswang can be recognised by the inverted reflection in its eye.

cultural_context.id: Karena aswang dianggap penyebab keguguran, masyarakat mengembangkan berbagai penangkal agar aswang tidak berkeliaran saat persalinan; kejahatannya juga dipahami sebagai kebalikan nilai kekeluargaan tradisional Filipina.
cultural_context.en: Because aswangs were blamed for miscarriages, people developed countermeasures to keep them away during childbirth; their evil is also understood as an inversion of traditional Filipino family values.

claims.quote: Aswang is a general term used to describe various evil and malevolent shape-shifting creatures found in Filipino folklore, such as vampires, ghouls, witches, viscera suckers, and transforming human-beast hybrids (usually dogs, cats, pigs).

statement.id: Aswang adalah istilah umum untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, seperti vampir, pemakan mayat, penyihir, pengisap isi perut, dan manusia yang menjelma binatang (biasanya anjing, kucing, babi).
statement.en: Aswang is a general term for various evil shape-shifting creatures in Filipino folklore, such as vampires, ghouls, witches, viscera suckers and human-beast hybrids (usually dogs, cats, pigs).

claims.quote: Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared among the mythical creatures of the Philippines, even in the 16th century.

statement.id: Penjajah Spanyol mencatat bahwa aswang adalah makhluk mitos yang paling ditakuti di Filipina, bahkan pada abad ke-16.
statement.en: Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared mythical creature of the Philippines, even in the 16th century.

claims.quote: The aswang is especially popular in the southern parts of Luzon, and some parts of Mindanao and Visayas, especially the Visayan province of Capiz.

statement.id: Aswang sangat populer di Luzon selatan dan sebagian Mindanao serta Visayas, terutama Provinsi Capiz.
statement.en: The aswang is especially popular in southern Luzon and parts of Mindanao and the Visayas, especially Capiz province.

claims.quote: Aswang is derived from Greater Central Philippine *aswang ("vampire," "evil spirit," or "witch"). Its cognates include Cebuano, Aklanon, Bikol, and Kapampangan aswang; Tagalog aswang, asuwang, or uswang

statement.id: Kata aswang berasal dari bahasa Greater Central Philippine *aswang ('vampir', 'roh jahat', atau 'penyihir'); dalam bahasa Tagalog juga ada bentuk asuwang dan uswang.
statement.en: Aswang derives from Greater Central Philippine *aswang ('vampire', 'evil spirit' or 'witch'); Tagalog also has asuwang and uswang.

claims.quote: These categories are the vampire, the self-segmenting viscera sucker, the weredog, the witch, and the ghoul.

statement.id: Menurut Maximo Ramos, golongan aswang adalah vampir, pengisap isi perut yang memisahkan tubuhnya, weredog, penyihir, dan pemakan mayat.
statement.en: According to Maximo Ramos, the aswang categories are the vampire, the self-segmenting viscera sucker, the weredog, the witch and the ghoul.

claims.quote: The vampire aswang takes on the appearance of a beautiful woman. It shares a diet of blood with vampires from Western cultures; however, it differs in that it sucks blood using a proboscis-like tongue rather than sharpened teeth.

statement.id: Aswang vampir berwujud perempuan cantik dan mengisap darah dengan lidah seperti belalai, bukan dengan gigi runcing.
statement.en: The vampire aswang looks like a beautiful woman and sucks blood with a proboscis-like tongue rather than sharp teeth.

claims.quote: By day, it takes the shape of an attractive, light-skinned, and long-haired woman. At night, it grows wings and segments itself, leaving behind its body from the waist downwards. It takes great care to hide its lower half, then flies in searches for victims. It is particularly attracted to fetuses developing inside pregnant women.

statement.id: Pada siang hari manananggal berwujud perempuan menarik; pada malam hari ia menumbuhkan sayap, meninggalkan tubuh dari pinggang ke bawah, lalu terbang mencari korban, terutama janin dalam kandungan.
statement.en: By day the manananggal looks like an attractive woman; at night it grows wings, leaves its body from the waist down, and flies in search of victims, especially fetuses in pregnant women.

claims.quote: Like the previous aswang, the weredog infiltrates villages and turns into a creature at night, around midnight. The creature is most commonly a dog, but a cat or pig is also possible.

statement.id: Weredog menyusup ke desa dan berubah wujud pada malam hari sekitar tengah malam, paling sering menjadi anjing, tetapi bisa juga kucing atau babi.
statement.en: The weredog infiltrates villages and transforms around midnight, most often into a dog but possibly a cat or pig.

claims.quote: Witch aswangs are characterized by extreme vindictiveness; they curse those who have crossed them by causing objects such as rice, bones, or insects to emerge from their victims' bodily orifices.

statement.id: Aswang penyihir sangat pendendam dan mengutuk orang yang menyinggungnya dengan membuat beras, tulang, atau serangga keluar dari lubang tubuh korban.
statement.en: Witch aswangs are extremely vindictive and curse those who cross them by making rice, bones or insects emerge from the victims' orifices.

claims.quote: Their diet consists of human corpses; they are carrion-eaters.

statement.id: Aswang pemakan mayat memakan jenazah manusia.
statement.en: Ghoul aswangs eat human corpses.

claims.quote: Aswangs commonly dwell at night in locations such as cemeteries and woods, as their powers are significantly, or sometimes totally, reduced during the daytime.

statement.id: Aswang biasanya berada di kuburan dan hutan pada malam hari, karena kekuatannya sangat berkurang atau hilang pada siang hari.
statement.en: Aswangs usually dwell in cemeteries and woods at night, since their powers are greatly or totally reduced by day.

claims.quote: Traditional aswang have no bias when selecting their prey and will not hesitate to target their own kin: an inversion of the traditional Filipino value of strong kinship and family closeness.

statement.id: Aswang tradisional tidak pilih-pilih mangsa dan tak segan memangsa kerabatnya sendiri, kebalikan dari nilai kekeluargaan tradisional Filipina.
statement.en: Traditional aswangs do not discriminate in prey and will target their own kin, an inversion of the traditional Filipino value of family closeness.

claims.quote: Holy objects, spices, salt, ash, the tail of a stingray, large crustaceans, vinegar, betel nut chew, and urine are all listed as tools for protection against aswang.

statement.id: Benda suci, rempah, garam, abu, ekor ikan pari, krustasea besar, cuka, sirih pinang, dan air seni tercatat sebagai penangkal aswang.
statement.en: Holy objects, spices, salt, ash, a stingray's tail, large crustaceans, vinegar, betel chew and urine are listed as protection against aswangs.

claims.quote: Once complete, the oil should be hung at the door of the house; it will boil when an aswang is near.

statement.id: Minyak anti-aswang digantung di pintu rumah dan akan mendidih bila aswang berada di dekatnya.
statement.en: The anti-aswang oil is hung at the door and boils when an aswang is near.

claims.quote: Because aswang were believed to be the cause of miscarriages, countermeasures to drive aswang away and prevent them from prowling during childbirth were developed.

statement.id: Karena aswang diyakini menyebabkan keguguran, berbagai penangkal dikembangkan agar mereka tidak berkeliaran saat persalinan.
statement.en: Because aswangs were believed to cause miscarriages, countermeasures were developed to keep them away during childbirth.

claims.quote: Ramos reasons that the creature of a given region is named after their most ferocious creature. As such, for example, Europe has werewolves, India has weretigers, and Africa has wereleopards. The Philippines has no indigenous wolf population, thus making weredog the more appropriate term.

statement.id: Ramos beralasan makhluk jelmaan tiap daerah dinamai menurut hewan paling buasnya; karena Filipina tidak punya serigala asli, istilah weredog lebih tepat.
statement.en: Ramos reasons each region's were-creature is named after its fiercest animal; the Philippines has no native wolves, so weredog is more fitting.

claims.quote: The eighth they called osuang, which is equivalent to "sorcerer;" they say that they have seen him fly, and that he murdered men and ate their flesh. This was among the Visayas Islands; among the Tagalos these did not exist.
claims.locator: Customs of the Tagalogs, daftar pelayan iblis

statement.id: Plasencia mencatat osuang, yang setara dengan 'tukang sihir'; orang mengaku melihatnya terbang, membunuh, dan memakan daging manusia; ini ada di Kepulauan Visayas, tidak di antara orang Tagalog.
statement.en: Plasencia recorded the osuang, equivalent to 'sorcerer'; people claimed to see it fly, kill men and eat their flesh; this was in the Visayas, not among the Tagalogs.

claims.quote: a shape shifting witch in Aswang (1992), or a village of ghoul-like creatures in Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999)

statement.id: Film Aswang (1992) menampilkan penyihir pengubah wujud, dan Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999) menampilkan desa makhluk mirip pemakan mayat.
statement.en: The film Aswang (1992) features a shape-shifting witch, and Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999) a village of ghoul-like creatures.

claims.quote: Within its pages, folkloric creatures are neatly placed into twelve categories; Demons, Dragons, Dwarves, Elves, Ghouls, Giants, Merfolk, Ogres, Vampires, Viscera Suckers, Were beasts, and Witches. What I found curious was that the aswang appeared in five of these categories

statement.id: Buku Ramos membagi makhluk folklor Filipina ke dalam dua belas golongan, dan aswang muncul di lima di antaranya.
statement.en: Ramos's book sorts Filipino folkloric creatures into twelve categories, and the aswang appears in five of them.

claims.quote: Moving to the next barangay will elicit a different yet equally assertive answer. Travelling throughout the country leaves one with hundreds of interpretations.

statement.id: Tiap barangay memberi jawaban berbeda tentang apa itu aswang, sehingga ada ratusan tafsiran di seluruh Filipina.
statement.en: Each barangay gives a different answer about what an aswang is, leaving hundreds of interpretations across the country.

claims.quote: Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589)

statement.id: Kutipan catatan sejarah tersebut berasal dari Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).
statement.en: The historical account quoted is from Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).

claims.quote: One example of a vampire aswang is the Tagalog mandurugo, said to live in the region of Capiz.

statement.id: Salah satu contoh aswang vampir adalah mandurugo Tagalog, yang konon tinggal di wilayah Capiz.
statement.en: One example of a vampire aswang is the Tagalog mandurugo, said to live in the Capiz region.

claims.quote: It is also believed to be the origin of the Eastern Indonesian beliefs in suangi (also keswange or iwangi; "evil spirit," "witch," or "ghost").

statement.id: Kata aswang juga diyakini menjadi asal kepercayaan suangi di Indonesia Timur ('roh jahat', 'penyihir', atau 'hantu').
statement.en: Aswang is also believed to be the origin of the Eastern Indonesian belief in suangi ('evil spirit', 'witch' or 'ghost').

short_description.id: Aswang adalah sebutan umum dalam cerita rakyat Filipina untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud, seperti vampir, penyihir, pemakan mayat, dan manusia yang menjelma binatang.
short_description.en: Aswang is a general term in Filipino folklore for a range of evil shape-shifting creatures, such as vampires, witches, corpse-eaters and humans who turn into beasts.

long_description.id: Aswang adalah istilah umum untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, mulai dari vampir, pemakan mayat, penyihir, pengisap isi perut, sampai manusia yang menjelma anjing, kucing, atau babi. Makhluk ini dikenal di seluruh Filipina, terutama di Luzon selatan, sebagian Mindanao dan Visayas, khususnya Provinsi Capiz. Penjajah Spanyol mencatat bahwa aswang adalah makhluk mitos yang paling ditakuti di Filipina sejak abad ke-16. Tiap daerah punya tafsiran sendiri, sehingga ada ratusan versi aswang di seluruh negeri.
long_description.en: Aswang is a general term for many evil shape-shifting creatures of Filipino folklore, from vampires, ghouls, witches and viscera suckers to humans who become dogs, cats or pigs. It is known throughout the Philippines, especially southern Luzon, parts of Mindanao and the Visayas, above all the province of Capiz. Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared mythical creature of the Philippines as early as the 16th century. Each community has its own interpretation, leaving hundreds of versions across the country.

long_description.id: Peneliti folklor Maximo Ramos membagi aswang ke dalam lima golongan: vampir, pengisap isi perut yang memisahkan tubuhnya, weredog, penyihir, dan pemakan mayat. Aswang vampir tampil sebagai perempuan cantik dan mengisap darah dengan lidah seperti belalai. Pengisap isi perut, atau manananggal, pada siang hari berwujud perempuan menarik, tetapi pada malam hari menumbuhkan sayap, meninggalkan tubuh bagian bawahnya, lalu terbang mencari mangsa, terutama janin di kandungan. Buku Ramos membagi makhluk folklor Filipina ke dalam dua belas golongan, dan aswang muncul di lima di antaranya.
long_description.en: Folklorist Maximo Ramos grouped the aswang into five groups: vampires, viscera suckers that split their bodies, weredogs, witches and ghouls. The vampire aswang appears as a beautiful woman and sucks blood with a proboscis-like tongue. The viscera sucker, or manananggal, looks like an attractive woman by day, but at night grows wings, leaves its lower body behind and flies in search of victims, especially unborn children. Ramos’s book sorts Filipino folkloric creatures into twelve categories, and the aswang appears in five of them.

long_description.id: Weredog menyusup ke desa sebagai pengembara, lalu sekitar tengah malam berubah menjadi anjing, kucing, atau babi dan memangsa manusia. Aswang penyihir sangat pendendam dan mengutuk korbannya dengan membuat benda seperti beras, tulang, atau serangga keluar dari lubang tubuh. Aswang pemakan mayat memakan jenazah dan berkumpul di pohon dekat kuburan untuk menggali makam yang masih baru.
long_description.en: The weredog enters villages as a traveller and around midnight turns into a dog, cat or pig and preys on people. Witch aswangs are extremely vindictive and curse victims by making objects such as rice, bones or insects come out of their bodily orifices. Ghoul aswangs eat corpses and gather in trees near cemeteries to dig up fresh burials.

long_description.id: Aswang biasanya berkeliaran pada malam hari di kuburan dan hutan, karena kekuatannya berkurang atau hilang pada siang hari, tetapi mereka juga bisa hidup di dalam desa. Mereka takut cahaya, sehingga rumah duka dulu dibuat terang agar aswang tidak datang mencuri jenazah. Perilakunya yang jahat dapat dibaca sebagai kebalikan nilai tradisional Filipina: aswang tidak segan memangsa kerabatnya sendiri.
long_description.en: Aswangs usually roam at night in cemeteries and woods, since their powers are reduced or lost by day, yet they can also live inside villages. They fear light, so wakes were brightly lit to keep aswangs from stealing the corpse. Their evil behaviour can be read as a reversal of traditional Filipino values: aswangs do not hesitate to prey on their own kin.

long_description.id: Ada banyak cara penangkal aswang, antara lain benda suci, rempah, garam, abu, ekor ikan pari, cuka, sirih pinang, dan air seni. Minyak khusus anti-aswang dipercaya mendidih bila aswang berada di dekatnya, dan aswang yang menyamar dapat dikenali dari bayangan yang terbalik di matanya.
long_description.en: There are many protections against aswangs, including holy objects, spices, salt, ash, a stingray's tail, vinegar, betel chew and urine. A special anti-aswang oil is believed to boil when an aswang is near, and a disguised aswang can be recognised by the inverted reflection in its eye.

cultural_context.id: Karena aswang dianggap penyebab keguguran, masyarakat mengembangkan berbagai penangkal agar aswang tidak berkeliaran saat persalinan; kejahatannya juga dipahami sebagai kebalikan nilai kekeluargaan tradisional Filipina.
cultural_context.en: Because aswangs were blamed for miscarriages, people developed countermeasures to keep them away during childbirth; their evil is also understood as an inversion of traditional Filipino family values.
